import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest'
import { execSync } from 'child_process'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url'
import { dirname, resolve } from 'path'
import postgres from 'postgres'
import { buildCustomSql } from './apply-custom-sql'

// Regressão do ordering 0015/0017: banco limpo quebrava em 0015
// (GRANT ... TO merp_app antes da role existir na 0017). A 0014_app_role_ensure
// garante a role cedo no stream; estes testes provam (a) migrations-só,
// (b) bootstrap-primeiro, (c) reaplicação e (d) RLS funcional pós-fix.
const dbAvailable = process.env.DB_AVAILABLE === 'true'

const OWNER_URL = 'postgres://merp:merp@localhost:5432/postgres'
const APP_PASSWORD = 'test-merp-app-pw'
const repoRoot = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..')
const stamp = `${Date.now().toString(36)}${process.pid.toString(36)}`
const dbA = `merp_reg_a_${stamp}`
const dbB = `merp_reg_b_${stamp}`

interface RoleAttrs {
  login: boolean
  bypassrls: boolean
  inherit: boolean
  hasPassword: boolean
}

// Divide o SQL concatenado em statements, respeitando dollar-quoting ($$),
// aspas e comentários — espelha o psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 (fail-fast por
// statement, sem máscara de erro).
function splitStatements(sql: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = []
  let cur = ''
  let i = 0
  let quote: string | null = null
  let dollar: string | null = null
  let lineComment = false
  let blockComment = false
  while (i < sql.length) {
    const c = sql[i]
    const two = sql.slice(i, i + 2)
    if (lineComment) {
      cur += c
      if (c === '\n') lineComment = false
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (blockComment) {
      cur += c
      if (two === '*/') {
        cur += sql[i + 1]
        i += 2
        blockComment = false
        continue
      }
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (quote) {
      cur += c
      if (c === quote && sql[i - 1] !== '\\') quote = null
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (dollar) {
      if (sql.startsWith(dollar, i)) {
        cur += dollar
        i += dollar.length
        dollar = null
        continue
      }
      cur += c
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (two === '--' && !cur.endsWith(':')) {
      // '--' fora de cast '::' — comentário de linha (casts não ocorrem aqui
      // colados em statement, mas a guarda evita falso-positivo barato)
      lineComment = true
      cur += c
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (two === '/*') {
      blockComment = true
      cur += two
      i += 2
      continue
    }
    if (c === "'" || c === '"') {
      quote = c
      cur += c
      i++
      continue
    }
    const m = /^\$[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\$|^\$\$/.exec(sql.slice(i))
    if (m) {
      dollar = m[0]
      cur += dollar
      i += dollar.length
      continue
    }
    if (c === ';') {
      cur += c
      out.push(cur)
      cur = ''
      i++
      continue
    }
    cur += c
    i++
  }
  if (cur.trim()) out.push(cur)
  // Descarta chunks só de comentários/espaço (psql os ignoraria).
  return out.filter((s) => s.replace(/--[^\n]*|\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '').trim())
}

async function freshDb(name: string): Promise<void> {
  const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
  try {
    await admin.unsafe(`CREATE DATABASE ${name} OWNER merp`)
  } finally {
    await admin.end()
  }
}

async function dropDb(name: string): Promise<void> {
  const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
  try {
    await admin.unsafe(`DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS ${name} WITH (FORCE)`)
  } finally {
    await admin.end()
  }
}

function pushSchema(dbUrl: string): void {
  try {
    execSync(`npx drizzle-kit push --config="${resolve(repoRoot, 'drizzle.config.ts')}"`, {
      cwd: repoRoot,
      env: { ...process.env, DATABASE_URL: dbUrl },
      encoding: 'utf-8',
      stdio: 'pipe',
      timeout: 240_000,
    })
  } catch (error: any) {
    // stdio pipe engole a saída — anexa para o flake ser diagnosticável.
    const out = [error?.stdout, error?.stderr].filter(Boolean).join('\n')
    throw new Error(`drizzle-kit push falhou: ${error?.message}${out ? `\n${out}` : ''}`)
  }
}

// Aplica o custom SQL statement a statement (fail-fast como ON_ERROR_STOP).
async function applyCustom(dbUrl: string): Promise<void> {
  const sql = postgres(dbUrl)
  try {
    for (const stmt of splitStatements(buildCustomSql())) {
      await sql.unsafe(stmt)
    }
  } finally {
    await sql.end()
  }
}

async function roleAttrs(): Promise<RoleAttrs | null> {
  const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
  try {
    const rows = await admin.unsafe(
      `SELECT rolcanlogin, rolbypassrls, rolinherit, rolpassword IS NOT NULL AS has_password FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'merp_app'`,
    )
    if (rows.length === 0) return null
    const r = rows[0] as any
    return {
      login: r.rolcanlogin,
      bypassrls: r.rolbypassrls,
      inherit: r.rolinherit,
      hasPassword: r.has_password,
    }
  } finally {
    await admin.end()
  }
}

// Garante existência SEM tocar em credencial: roles são cluster-globais e os
// demais arquivos de integração autenticam como merp_app/'merp_app' em
// paralelo — um ALTER ROLE ... PASSWORD aqui causaria flake na suíte.
// A parte de existência é o que importa para o ordering (o bug era
// 'role does not exist'); a cláusula PASSWORD do ensureAppRole já é exercida
// pelo próprio globalSetup em CI.
async function ensureRoleExists(): Promise<void> {
  const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
  try {
    await admin.unsafe(
      `DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'merp_app') THEN CREATE ROLE merp_app WITH LOGIN; END IF; END $$;`,
    )
  } finally {
    await admin.end()
  }
}

async function rolePreExists(): Promise<boolean> {
  const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
  try {
    const rows = await admin.unsafe(`SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'merp_app'`)
    return rows.length > 0
  } finally {
    await admin.end()
  }
}

const urlFor = (db: string, user = 'merp', pw = 'merp') =>
  `postgres://${user}:${pw}@localhost:5432/${db}`

describe.skipIf(!dbAvailable)('migration ordering 0015/0017 (integration)', () => {
  let attrsA: RoleAttrs | null = null
  let preExisted = false

  beforeAll(async () => {
    preExisted = await rolePreExists()
    // (a) banco limpo, migrations-só, sem criar a role manualmente.
    await freshDb(dbA)
    pushSchema(urlFor(dbA))
    await applyCustom(urlFor(dbA))
    attrsA = await roleAttrs()

    // (b) banco limpo, bootstrap (existência) primeiro.
    await freshDb(dbB)
    await ensureRoleExists()
    pushSchema(urlFor(dbB))
    await applyCustom(urlFor(dbB))
  }, 300_000)

  afterAll(async () => {
    await dropDb(dbA).catch(() => {})
    await dropDb(dbB).catch(() => {})
  })

  it('(a) migrations-só passam e criam merp_app com atributos RLS-safe', () => {
    // Se a 0014_app_role_ensure regredir, o applyCustom acima lança
    // 'role "merp_app" does not exist' e este teste falha no beforeAll.
    expect(attrsA).toMatchObject({ login: true, bypassrls: false, inherit: true })
    // Em cluster 100% limpo a migration cria a role sem senha (credencial é
    // da operação/bootstrap). Com globalSetup ativo a role já existe — aí a
    // não-interferência é coberta por (c).
    if (!preExisted) expect(attrsA?.hasPassword).toBe(false)
  })

  it('(c) reaplicar em banco migrado passa e não altera a role', async () => {
    const before = await roleAttrs()
    await applyCustom(urlFor(dbA))
    expect(await roleAttrs()).toEqual(before)
  })

  it('(b) bootstrap-primeiro resulta nos mesmos atributos de (a)', async () => {
    const attrsB = await roleAttrs()
    expect(attrsB).not.toBeNull()
    // Existência + atributos idênticos independente de quem criou primeiro.
    expect({
      login: attrsB?.login,
      bypassrls: attrsB?.bypassrls,
      inherit: attrsB?.inherit,
    }).toEqual({ login: attrsA?.login, bypassrls: attrsA?.bypassrls, inherit: attrsA?.inherit })
  })

  describe('(d) RLS funcional pós-fix', () => {
    const OWNER = 'rls-u-owner'
    const OUTSIDER = 'rls-u-out'
    const CO_A = 'rls-c-a'
    const CO_B = 'rls-c-b'
    // Role descartável membro de merp_app: herda os mesmos grants (INHERIT),
    // mas continua NOBYPASSRLS (bypass não se herda) — exerce exatamente as
    // mesmas policies, sem mutar a credencial global de merp_app (paralelismo).
    const PROBE = `rls_probe_${stamp}`

    // Conexão dedicada como probe com GUCs de tenant/user (como withTenant).
    async function asApp<T>(
      tenant: string | null,
      user: string,
      fn: (sql: any) => Promise<T>,
    ): Promise<T> {
      const sql = postgres(urlFor(dbA, PROBE, APP_PASSWORD))
      try {
        await sql.unsafe(`SET app.tenant_id = '${tenant ?? ''}'`)
        await sql.unsafe(`SET app.user_id = '${user}'`)
        return await fn(sql)
      } finally {
        await sql.end()
      }
    }

    beforeAll(async () => {
      const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
      try {
        await admin.unsafe(`CREATE ROLE ${PROBE} WITH LOGIN PASSWORD '${APP_PASSWORD}'`)
        await admin.unsafe(`GRANT merp_app TO ${PROBE}`)
      } finally {
        await admin.end()
      }
      // Seed como owner (superuser bypassa RLS).
      const owner = postgres(urlFor(dbA))
      try {
        await owner.unsafe(
          `INSERT INTO "user" (id, name, email) VALUES ('${OWNER}', 'Owner', 'rls-owner@example.com'), ('${OUTSIDER}', 'Outsider', 'rls-outsider@example.com') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING`,
        )
        await owner.unsafe(
          `INSERT INTO company (id, name) VALUES ('${CO_A}', 'RLS Co A'), ('${CO_B}', 'RLS Co B') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING`,
        )
        await owner.unsafe(
          `INSERT INTO company_member (company_id, user_id, role) VALUES ('${CO_A}', '${OWNER}', 'owner') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
        )
      } finally {
        await owner.end()
      }
    }, 60_000)

    afterAll(async () => {
      const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
      try {
        await admin.unsafe(`DROP ROLE IF EXISTS ${PROBE}`)
      } finally {
        await admin.end().catch(() => {})
      }
    })

    it('só enxerga rows do tenant corrente (policy ativa)', async () => {
      const rows = await asApp(CO_A, OWNER, (sql) =>
        sql.unsafe(`SELECT id FROM company ORDER BY id`),
      )
      expect(rows.map((r: any) => r.id)).toEqual([CO_A])
    })

    it('sem contexto o outsider não vê nada (fail-closed)', async () => {
      const rows = await asApp(null, OUTSIDER, (sql) => sql.unsafe(`SELECT * FROM company_member`))
      expect(rows).toHaveLength(0)
    })

    it('self-insert de outsider em outro tenant é negado (42501)', async () => {
      await expect(
        asApp(CO_B, OUTSIDER, (sql) =>
          sql.unsafe(
            `INSERT INTO company_member (company_id, user_id, role) VALUES ('${CO_B}', '${OUTSIDER}', 'member')`,
          ),
        ),
      ).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: '42501' })
    })

    it('role de migration continua enxergando tudo', async () => {
      const owner = postgres(urlFor(dbA))
      try {
        const companies = await owner.unsafe(`SELECT id FROM company ORDER BY id`)
        expect(companies.map((r: any) => r.id)).toEqual([CO_A, CO_B])
        const members = await owner.unsafe(`SELECT * FROM company_member`)
        expect(members).toHaveLength(1)
      } finally {
        await owner.end()
      }
    })
  })
})

## FILE: server/api/auth/companies.delete.post.ts

```
import { defineEventHandler, readBody, createError } from 'h3'
import { companyRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository'
import { createAuthEvent } from '~~/server/utils/shared/audit'
import { getClientIp } from '~~/server/utils/shared/ip'
import {
  sendValidationError,
  sendNotFoundError,
  assertCompanyRole,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const user = event.context.user as { id: string; email: string } | undefined
  if (!user) {
    throw createError({
      status: 401,
      statusText: '401',
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    })
  }

  const body = await readBody<{ companyId?: string }>(event)

  if (!body?.companyId || typeof body.companyId !== 'string') {
    sendValidationError('companyId is required')
  }

  const company = await companyRepository.findCompanyById(body.companyId, user.id)
  if (!company) {
    sendNotFoundError('Company not found')
  }

  const role = await companyRepository.getCompanyMembershipRole(user.id, body.companyId)
  await assertCompanyRole(
    role,
    'owner',
    'You are not a member of this company',
    'Only company owners can delete companies',
  )

  await companyRepository.softDeleteCompany(body.companyId, user.id)

  const ip = getClientIp(event)
  await createAuthEvent({
    userId: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    eventType: 'company_deleted',
    ipAddress: ip || null,
    metadata: { companyId: body.companyId },
  })

  return { message: 'Company deleted successfully' }
})

## FILE: server/api/auth/companies.get.ts

```
import { defineEventHandler, getQuery, createError } from 'h3'
import { companyRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository'
import { MAX_SEARCH_QUERY_LENGTH } from '~~/server/utils/shared/security'
import { sendValidationError } from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const user = event.context.user as { id: string } | undefined
  if (!user) {
    throw createError({
      status: 401,
      statusText: '401',
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    })
  }

  const query = getQuery<{ q?: string }>(event)

  if (!query.q || typeof query.q !== 'string' || query.q.trim().length === 0) {
    sendValidationError('Search query is required')
  }

  // AUD-14: teto de tamanho — padrão LIKE gigante custaria varredura string
  // desproporcional em cada linha.
  if (query.q.trim().length > MAX_SEARCH_QUERY_LENGTH) {
    sendValidationError('Search query must be at most 100 characters')
  }

  // AUD-10: escopada por vínculo — o repositório só retorna empresas onde
  // user.id é member (antes: busca global, vazava nome+CNPJ de tudo).
  const companies = await companyRepository.searchCompanies(query.q.trim(), user.id)

  return { companies: companies.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, cnpj: c.cnpj })) }
})

      status: 401,
      statusText: '401',
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    })
  }

  const body = await readBody<{ companyId?: string; userId?: string }>(event)

  if (!body?.companyId || typeof body.companyId !== 'string') {
    sendValidationError('companyId is required')
  }

  if (body.userId !== undefined && (typeof body.userId !== 'string' || body.userId.trim() === '')) {
    sendValidationError('userId must be a non-empty string')
  }

  const company = await companyRepository.findCompanyById(body.companyId, user.id)
  if (!company) {
    sendNotFoundError('Company not found')
  }

  const role = await companyRepository.getCompanyMembershipRole(user.id, body.companyId)

  if (!body.userId) {
    // Leave: o member remove a si mesmo
    await assertCompanyRole(role, null, 'You are not a member of this company')

    if (role === 'owner') {
      sendForbiddenError('Cannot remove a company owner')
    }

    await companyRepository.removeCompanyMember(body.companyId, user.id, user.id)

    const ip = getClientIp(event)
    await createAuthEvent({
      userId: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      eventType: 'member_removed',
      ipAddress: ip || null,
      metadata: { companyId: body.companyId, removedUserId: user.id },
    })

    return { message: 'Left company successfully' }
  }

  // Owner remove outro member
  await assertCompanyRole(
    role,
    'owner',
    'You are not a member of this company',
    'Only company owners can remove members',
  )

  const targetRole = await companyRepository.getCompanyMembershipRole(body.userId, body.companyId)
  if (!targetRole) {
    sendNotFoundError('Company member not found')
  }

  if (targetRole === 'owner') {
    sendForbiddenError('Cannot remove a company owner')
  }

  await companyRepository.removeCompanyMember(body.companyId, user.id, body.userId)

  const ip = getClientIp(event)
  await createAuthEvent({
    userId: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    eventType: 'member_removed',
    ipAddress: ip || null,
    metadata: { companyId: body.companyId, removedUserId: body.userId },
  })

  return { message: 'Member removed successfully' }
})

## FILE: server/api/auth/companies.post.ts

```
import { defineEventHandler, readBody, createError, setResponseStatus } from 'h3'
import { companyRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository'
import {
  checkIpRateLimit,
  isValidCnpj,
  MAX_CNPJ_LENGTH,
  MAX_COMPANY_NAME_LENGTH,
  MAX_RAZAO_SOCIAL_LENGTH,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/security'
import { sendValidationError } from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  // AUD-14: rate limit por IP antes do readBody (mesmo padrão do invite.post,
  // AUD-11) — criação de empresa é mutação barata de abusar (INSERT por
  // request, sem teto por sessão).
  await checkIpRateLimit(event)

  const user = event.context.user as { id: string } | undefined
  if (!user) {
    throw createError({
      status: 401,
      statusText: '401',
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    })
  }

  const body = await readBody<{ name?: string; cnpj?: string; razaoSocial?: string }>(event)

  if (!body.name || typeof body.name !== 'string' || body.name.trim().length === 0) {
    sendValidationError('Company name is required')
  }

  // AUD-21: tetos de tamanho — PII corporativa não vira coluna gigante.
  if (body.name.trim().length > MAX_COMPANY_NAME_LENGTH) {
    sendValidationError('Company name must be at most 200 characters')
  }

  // AUD-23: body types lax → TypeError → 500; validar antes de trim.
  if (body.cnpj !== undefined && typeof body.cnpj !== 'string') {
    sendValidationError('cnpj must be a string')
  }
  const cnpj = body.cnpj?.trim() || undefined
  if (cnpj && cnpj.length > MAX_CNPJ_LENGTH) {
    sendValidationError('cnpj must be at most 30 characters')
  }
  if (cnpj && !isValidCnpj(cnpj)) {
    sendValidationError('cnpj is invalid')
  }

  if (body.razaoSocial !== undefined && typeof body.razaoSocial !== 'string') {
    sendValidationError('razaoSocial must be a string')
  }
  const razaoSocial = body.razaoSocial?.trim() || undefined
  if (razaoSocial && razaoSocial.length > MAX_RAZAO_SOCIAL_LENGTH) {
    sendValidationError('razaoSocial must be at most 200 characters')
  }

  const created = await companyRepository.createCompanyWithOwner(
    {
      name: body.name.trim(),
      cnpj,
      razaoSocial,
    },
    user.id,
  )

  setResponseStatus(event, 201)
  return {
    id: created.id,
    name: created.name,
  }
})

## FILE: server/api/auth/companies.switch.post.ts

```
import { defineEventHandler, readBody, createError } from 'h3'
import { companyRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository'
import {
  sendValidationError,
  sendNotFoundError,
  sendForbiddenError,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const user = event.context.user as { id: string } | undefined
  const currentSession = event.context.session as { id: string } | undefined
  if (!user || !currentSession) {
    throw createError({
      status: 401,
      statusText: '401',
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    })
  }

  const body = await readBody<{ companyId?: string }>(event)

  if (!body.companyId || typeof body.companyId !== 'string') {
    sendValidationError('Company ID is required')
  }

  const company = await companyRepository.findCompanyById(body.companyId, user.id)
  if (!company) {
    sendNotFoundError('Company not found or deleted')
  }

  const isMember = await companyRepository.isCompanyMember(user.id, body.companyId)
  if (!isMember) {
    sendForbiddenError('User is not a member of the specified company')
  }

  await companyRepository.setActiveCompany(currentSession.id, body.companyId, user.id)

  event.context.activeCompanyId = body.companyId

  return { message: 'Active company switched' }
})

import { defineEventHandler, readBody, createError } from 'h3'
import { companyRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository'
import { createAuthEvent } from '~~/server/utils/shared/audit'
import { getClientIp } from '~~/server/utils/shared/ip'
import {
  isValidCnpj,
  MAX_CNPJ_LENGTH,
  MAX_COMPANY_NAME_LENGTH,
  MAX_RAZAO_SOCIAL_LENGTH,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/security'
import {
  sendValidationError,
  sendNotFoundError,
  assertCompanyRole,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const user = event.context.user as { id: string; email: string } | undefined
  if (!user) {
    throw createError({
      status: 401,
      statusText: '401',
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    })
  }

  const body = await readBody<{
    companyId?: string
    name?: string
    cnpj?: string
    razaoSocial?: string
  }>(event)

  if (!body?.companyId || typeof body.companyId !== 'string') {
    sendValidationError('companyId is required')
  }

  const input: { name?: string; cnpj?: string; razaoSocial?: string } = {}
  if (body.name !== undefined) {
    if (typeof body.name !== 'string' || body.name.trim().length === 0) {
      sendValidationError('Company name must be a non-empty string')
    }
    const name = body.name.trim()
    if (name.length > MAX_COMPANY_NAME_LENGTH) {
      sendValidationError('Company name must be at most 200 characters')
    }
    input.name = name
  }
  if (body.cnpj !== undefined) {
    if (typeof body.cnpj !== 'string') {
      sendValidationError('cnpj must be a string')
    }
    const cnpj = body.cnpj.trim() || undefined
    if (cnpj && cnpj.length > MAX_CNPJ_LENGTH) {
      sendValidationError('cnpj must be at most 30 characters')
    }
    if (cnpj && !isValidCnpj(cnpj)) {
      sendValidationError('cnpj is invalid')
    }
    input.cnpj = cnpj
  }
  if (body.razaoSocial !== undefined) {
    if (typeof body.razaoSocial !== 'string') {
      sendValidationError('razaoSocial must be a string')
    }
    const razaoSocial = body.razaoSocial.trim() || undefined
    if (razaoSocial && razaoSocial.length > MAX_RAZAO_SOCIAL_LENGTH) {
      sendValidationError('razaoSocial must be at most 200 characters')
    }
    input.razaoSocial = razaoSocial
  }
  if (Object.keys(input).length === 0) {
    sendValidationError('At least one field (name, cnpj, razaoSocial) is required')
  }

  const company = await companyRepository.findCompanyById(body.companyId, user.id)
  if (!company) {
    sendNotFoundError('Company not found')
  }

  const role = await companyRepository.getCompanyMembershipRole(user.id, body.companyId)
  await assertCompanyRole(
    role,
    'owner',
    'You are not a member of this company',
    'Only company owners can update companies',
  )

  const updated = await companyRepository.updateCompany(body.companyId, user.id, input)

  const ip = getClientIp(event)
  await createAuthEvent({
    userId: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    eventType: 'company_updated',
    ipAddress: ip || null,
    metadata: { companyId: body.companyId },
  })

  return updated
})

import { identityRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository'
import { createAuthEvent } from '~~/server/utils/shared/audit'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const user = event.context.user as { id: string; email: string } | undefined

  if (!user) {

      statusText: '401',
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    })
  }

    eventType: 'consent_withdrawal',
    ipAddress: ip || null,
    metadata: {

    },
  })

  return { message: 'Consent withdrawn successfully' }
})

```
import { defineEventHandler, createError } from 'h3'
import { identityRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository'
import { createAuthEvent } from '~~/server/utils/shared/audit'
import { getClientIp } from '~~/server/utils/shared/ip'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const user = event.context.user as { id: string; email: string } | undefined

  if (!user) {
    throw createError({
      status: 401,
      statusText: '401',
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    })
  }

  await identityRepository.deactivateUser(user.id)

  const ip = getClientIp(event)
  const session = event.context.session as
    | { id: string; activeCompanyId?: string | null }
    | undefined

  // FR-023: session_invalidated — deactivateUser encerrou todas as sessões do
  // usuário; sessionId da sessão atual é registrado quando disponível.
  await createAuthEvent({
    userId: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    eventType: 'session_invalidated',
    ipAddress: ip || null,
    metadata: {
      sessionId: session?.id ?? null,
      userId: user.id,
      tenantId: session?.activeCompanyId ?? null,
    },
  })

  await createAuthEvent({
    userId: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    eventType: 'deactivation',
    ipAddress: ip || null,
  })

  return { message: 'Account deactivated successfully' }
})

import { defineEventHandler, createError } from 'h3'
import { identityRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository'
import { companyRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const user = event.context.user as
    | {
        id: string
        email: string
        name: string | null
      }
    | undefined

  if (!user) {
    throw createError({
      status: 401,
      statusText: '401',
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    })
  }

  const [fullUser, companies, sessions, authEvents] = await Promise.all([
    identityRepository.findById(user.id),
    companyRepository.findUserCompanies(user.id),
    identityRepository.getUserSessions(user.id),
    identityRepository.listUserAuthEvents(user.id),
  ])

  return {
    profile: {
      id: fullUser?.id || user.id,
      email: user.email,
      name: user.name,
      createdAt: fullUser?.createdAt,
    },
    companies: companies.map((c) => ({
      id: c.id,
      name: c.name,
      cnpj: c.cnpj,
      razaoSocial: c.razaoSocial,
      role: c.role,
    })),
    sessions: sessions.map((s) => ({
      id: s.id,
      createdAt: s.createdAt,
      expiresAt: s.expiresAt,
    })),
    authEvents: authEvents.map((e) => ({
      id: e.id,
      eventType: e.eventType,
      ipAddress: e.ipAddress,
      createdAt: e.createdAt,
    })),
  }
})

## FILE: server/api/auth/forget-password.post.ts

```
import { defineEventHandler, readBody } from 'h3'
import { identityRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository'
import {
  checkEmailRateLimit,
  checkIpRateLimit,
  EMAIL_REGEX,
  MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH,
  normalizeEmail,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/security'
import { sendValidationError } from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'

// AUD-04: "esqueci minha senha". Resposta genérica e idêntica para email
// existente ou não (anti-enumeração embutida no better-auth).
export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  await checkIpRateLimit(event)

  const body = await readBody<{ email?: string }>(event)

  const email = typeof body?.email === 'string' ? normalizeEmail(body.email) : ''
  if (!email || !EMAIL_REGEX.test(email)) {
    sendValidationError('Valid email is required')
  }

  // AUD-14: teto antes do checkEmailRateLimit — email gigante não vira chave.
  if (email.length > MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH) {
    sendValidationError('Valid email is required')
  }

  await checkEmailRateLimit(event, email)

  await identityRepository.requestPasswordReset(email)

  return {
    status: true,
    message: 'If this email exists in our system, check your email for the reset link',
  }
})

## FILE: server/api/auth/invite.post.ts

```
import { defineEventHandler, readBody, createError, setResponseStatus } from 'h3'
import { companyRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository'
import { inviteRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/invite/repository'
import {
  sendValidationError,
  sendNotFoundError,
  assertCompanyRole,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'
import { createAuthEvent } from '~~/server/utils/shared/audit'
import { getClientIp } from '~~/server/utils/shared/ip'
import {
  checkIpRateLimit,
  EMAIL_REGEX,
  MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH,
  normalizeEmail,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/security'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  // AUD-11: rate limit por IP antes do readBody (mesmo padrão das rotas
  // públicas) — criação de convites é mutação barata de abusar.
  await checkIpRateLimit(event)

  const user = event.context.user as { id: string; email: string } | undefined
  if (!user) {
    throw createError({
      status: 401,
      statusText: '401',
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    })
  }

  const body = await readBody<{ companyId?: string; email?: string }>(event)

  if (!body?.companyId || typeof body.companyId !== 'string') {
    sendValidationError('companyId is required')
  }

  const email = typeof body?.email === 'string' ? normalizeEmail(body.email) : ''
  if (!email || !EMAIL_REGEX.test(email)) {
    sendValidationError('A valid email is required')
  }

  // AUD-14: teto de tamanho — email gigante não vira linha/PII desproporcional
  // nem chave de auditoria inválida.
  if (email.length > MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH) {
    sendValidationError('A valid email is required')
  }

  const company = await companyRepository.findCompanyById(body.companyId, user.id)
  if (!company) {
    sendNotFoundError('Company not found')
  }

  const role = await companyRepository.getCompanyMembershipRole(user.id, body.companyId)
  await assertCompanyRole(
    role,
    'owner',
    'You are not a member of this company',
    'Only company owners can invite members',
  )

  const created = await inviteRepository.createInvite({
    companyId: body.companyId,
    email: email!,
    invitedBy: user.id,
  })

  const ip = getClientIp(event)
  await createAuthEvent({
    userId: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    eventType: 'invite_created',
    ipAddress: ip || null,
    metadata: { companyId: body.companyId, invitedEmail: email },
  })

  setResponseStatus(event, 201)
  return {
    id: created.id,
    companyId: created.companyId,
    email: created.email,
    expiresAt: created.expiresAt,
    // AUD-01: token de aceite — devolvido UMA única vez nesta resposta.
    // Nunca reaparece em invites.get nem em logs de auditoria.
    token: created.token,
  }
})

```

## FILE: server/api/auth/invites.accept.post.ts

```
import { defineEventHandler, readBody, createError } from 'h3'
import { inviteRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/invite/repository'
import { sendValidationError } from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'
import { createAuthEvent } from '~~/server/utils/shared/audit'
import { getClientIp } from '~~/server/utils/shared/ip'
import { checkIpRateLimit } from '~~/server/utils/shared/security'

// AUD-01: aceite por token secreto de uso único (256 bits). O token já
// identifica o convite (linha tem company_id) — companyId não precisa ser
// enviado. Respostas de erro são genéricas (404 "not found or expired"):
// token inválido/expirado/reaplicado são indistinguíveis (anti-enumeração).
export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  // AUD-11: rate limit por IP — tentativas de aceite por token são mutações
  // (claim + INSERT) e devem ser limitadas como as demais.
  await checkIpRateLimit(event)

  const user = event.context.user as { id: string; email: string } | undefined
  if (!user) {
    throw createError({
      status: 401,
      statusText: '401',
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    })
  }

  const body = await readBody<{ token?: string }>(event)

  if (!body?.token || typeof body.token !== 'string' || body.token.length === 0) {
    sendValidationError('token is required')
  }

  const accepted = await inviteRepository.acceptInvite(body.token, user.email, user.id)

  const ip = getClientIp(event)
  await createAuthEvent({
    userId: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    eventType: 'invite_accepted',
    ipAddress: ip || null,
    metadata: { companyId: accepted.companyId },
  })

  return {
    id: accepted.id,
    companyId: accepted.companyId,
    acceptedAt: accepted.acceptedAt,
  }
})

import { defineEventHandler, getQuery, createError } from 'h3'
import { companyRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository'
import { inviteRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/invite/repository'
import {
  sendValidationError,
  sendNotFoundError,
  assertCompanyRole,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const user = event.context.user as { id: string } | undefined
  if (!user) {
    throw createError({
      status: 401,
      statusText: '401',
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    })
  }

  const query = getQuery<{ companyId?: string }>(event)

  if (!query?.companyId || typeof query.companyId !== 'string') {
    sendValidationError('companyId is required')
  }

  const company = await companyRepository.findCompanyById(query.companyId, user.id)
  if (!company) {
    sendNotFoundError('Company not found')
  }

  const role = await companyRepository.getCompanyMembershipRole(user.id, query.companyId)
  await assertCompanyRole(role, null, 'You are not a member of this company')

  const invites = await inviteRepository.listCompanyInvites(query.companyId)

  return { invites }
})

## FILE: server/api/auth/login.post.ts

```
import { defineEventHandler, readBody, appendResponseHeaders } from 'h3'
import { logger } from '#shared/logger'
import { identityRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository'
import {
  checkAccountLockout,
  checkEmailRateLimit,
  checkIpRateLimit,
  MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH,
  MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH,
  normalizeEmail,
  recordFailedAttempt,
  resetFailedAttempts,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/security'
import {
  sendAuthError,
  sendUnauthorizedError,
  sendValidationError,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'
import { createAuthEvent } from '~~/server/utils/shared/audit'
import { background } from '~~/server/utils/shared/background'
import { sendDeactivationNotice } from '~~/server/utils/shared/email'
import { getClientIp } from '~~/server/utils/shared/ip'

// LOCKOUT_EXEMPT_ERROR_CODES marca os codes que NÃO contam para lockout
// (conta desativada não bloqueia o dono por 30min; email não-verificado tem
// a senha CORRETA comprovada — bloquear seria punir a vítima). Nada aqui é
// repassado como 401 genérico: o motivo específico fica apenas na auditoria
// interna, exceto email_not_verified (403 explícito — ver abaixo).
const LOCKOUT_EXEMPT_ERROR_CODES = new Set(['account_deactivated', 'email_not_verified'])

function getLoginErrorReason(error: any): string {
  const status = error?.statusCode ?? error?.status
  if (status !== 401 && status !== 403) return 'unknown'
  if (typeof error?.message === 'string') {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(error.message)
      if (typeof parsed?.error === 'string') {
        return LOCKOUT_EXEMPT_ERROR_CODES.has(parsed.error) ? parsed.error : 'invalid_credentials'
      }
    } catch {
      // message não é JSON — erro genérico
    }
  }
  return 'invalid_credentials'
}

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  await checkIpRateLimit(event)

  const body = await readBody<{ email?: string; password?: string; rememberMe?: boolean }>(event)

  const email = typeof body?.email === 'string' ? normalizeEmail(body.email) : ''
  // AUD-23: typeof password entra na validação — senha numérica passava por
  // !body?.password e derrubava no `.length`/scrypt com TypeError → 500.
  if (!email || typeof body?.password !== 'string' || !body.password) {
    sendValidationError('Email and password are required')
  }

  // AUD-14: tetos de tamanho ANTES do checkEmailRateLimit — email gigante não
  // pode virar chave `rate:`/`lockout:` (PK text; índice btree quebra → 503)
  // nem pagar scrypt em senha de megabytes. Resposta 401 genérico idêntica a
  // credenciais inválidas: nenhuma conta legítima passa dos tetos (register
  // impõe os mesmos) — zero oráculo de enumeração, timing uniforme.
  if (email.length > MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH || body.password.length > MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH) {
    sendUnauthorizedError('Invalid email or password')
  }

  // AUD-02: IP resolvido uma vez no início — o lockout é chaveado por
  // (email + IP) para que 10 falhas de um IP não bloqueiem a vítima.
  let ip: string | null = null
  try {
    ip = getClientIp(event) ?? null
  } catch {
    // Sem socket (ex.: eventos de teste) — apenas a camada global por email.
  }

  await checkEmailRateLimit(event, email)

  try {
    await checkAccountLockout(email, ip)
  } catch (error) {
    // A conta está bloqueada, mas o cliente recebe o mesmo 401 genérico de
    // credenciais inválidas (anti-enumeração). O motivo fica na auditoria.
    if (getLoginErrorReason(error) === 'invalid_credentials') {
      // AUD-11: getClientIp fora do try/catch mascararia o erro de lockout com
      // um 500 espúrio (sem socket, ex.: eventos de teste) — auditoria sem IP.
      let auditIp: string | null = null
      try {
        auditIp = getClientIp(event)
      } catch {
        // Sem socket — auditoria sem IP.
      }
      await createAuthEvent({
        email,
        eventType: 'failed_login',
        ipAddress: auditIp,
        metadata: { reason: 'account_locked' },
      })
      sendUnauthorizedError('Invalid email or password')
    }
    throw error
  }

  try {
    const user = await identityRepository.signIn(
      {
        email,
        password: body.password,
        rememberMe: body.rememberMe === true,
      },
      event.headers,
    )

    // AUD-14: reset de lockout não pode derrubar um login de sucesso — se a
    // limpeza falhar (DB hiccup), a sessão já foi criada pelo better-auth;
    // virar 503 aqui devolveria erro com sessão órfã + auditoria failed_login
    // reason 'unknown' enganosa. Loga e entrega o login; contadores stale
    // expiram em 30min/24h (purge-security-state).
    try {
      await resetFailedAttempts(email, ip)
    } catch (error) {
      logger.warn('Failed to reset failed attempts after successful login', {
        email,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      })
    }

    if (user.setCookie.length > 0) {
      appendResponseHeaders(event, { 'set-cookie': user.setCookie })
    }

    // AUD-13: fire-and-forget (padrão FR-023) — o Set-Cookie de sessão já foi
    // anexado; se a auditoria falhasse com await, o cliente receberia 503 com
    // sessão válida criada (estado inconsistente + sessões órfãs em retries).
    background(
      event,
      createAuthEvent({
        userId: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        eventType: 'login',
        ipAddress: ip,
      }),
      'login',
    )

    return {
      id: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      name: user.name,
    }
  } catch (error: any) {
    const reason = getLoginErrorReason(error)

    await createAuthEvent({
      email,
      eventType: 'failed_login',
      ipAddress: ip,
      metadata: { reason },
    })

    // Lockout conta apenas tentativas de credencial inválida: falhas de
    // infraestrutura (503/500) ou conta desativada não devem bloquear o
    // usuário por 30 min.
    if (reason === 'invalid_credentials') {
      await recordFailedAttempt(email, ip)
    }

    if (reason === 'account_deactivated') {
      // Fire-and-forget: não aguardamos o envio para preservar o timing
      // equalizado do AUD-07 (um await no Resend adicionaria ~100-500ms ao
      // caminho desativado, reintroduzindo o oráculo de timing). Premissa: o
      // processo Node persiste vivo o suficiente para concluir o fetch
      // pendente após a resposta ser enviada — NÃO é seguro em presets
      // serverless/edge (sem waitUntil disponível).
      background(event, sendDeactivationNotice(email), 'deactivation-notice')
      sendUnauthorizedError('Invalid email or password')
    }

    if (reason === 'email_not_verified') {
      // AUD-04: 403 explícito — exceção deliberada ao 401 genérico. Só é
      // alcançado com a senha CORRETA (o better-auth verifica o scrypt antes
      // do check de email_verified), então não vaza existência de conta para
      // quem não tem as credenciais. O link de verificação é enviado no
      // mesmo fluxo (sendOnSignIn). Não conta para lockout.
      sendAuthError(
        403,
        'email_not_verified',
        'Please verify your email address before logging in.',
      )
    }

    if (error?.statusCode === 401) {
      sendUnauthorizedError('Invalid email or password')
    }

    throw error
  }
})

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

const mockGetAuth = vi.fn()
const mockSignOut = vi.fn()
const mockCreateAuthEvent = vi.fn()
const mockSendUnauthorizedError = vi.fn()
const mockSendAuthUnavailableError = vi.fn()
const mockGetClientIp = vi.fn()
const mockAppendResponseHeaders = vi.fn()

vi.mock('h3', () => ({
  defineEventHandler: (fn: any) => fn,
  appendResponseHeaders: mockAppendResponseHeaders,
  createError: (opts: any) => {
    const err = new Error(opts.message)
    ;(err as any).status = opts.status
    ;(err as any).statusCode = opts.status
    throw err
  },
}))
vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/ip', () => ({
  getClientIp: mockGetClientIp,
}))

vi.mock('#shared/auth', () => ({
  getAuth: mockGetAuth,
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/errors', () => ({
  sendUnauthorizedError: mockSendUnauthorizedError,
  sendAuthUnavailableError: mockSendAuthUnavailableError,
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/audit', () => ({
  createAuthEvent: mockCreateAuthEvent,
}))

describe('POST /api/auth/logout', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    mockGetAuth.mockResolvedValue({ api: { signOut: mockSignOut } })
    mockSendUnauthorizedError.mockImplementation((msg: string) => {
      throw new Error(msg)
    })
    mockSendAuthUnavailableError.mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error('Authentication service is starting. Please try again.')
    })
  })

  it('returns 200 with success message on logout', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/logout.post').then((m) => m.default)
    mockSignOut.mockResolvedValue({ headers: new Headers(), response: { success: true } })

    const event = {
      context: {
        session: { id: 'session-123' },
      },
      headers: new Headers(),
    } as any

    const result = await handler(event)

    expect(result).toEqual({ message: 'Logged out successfully' })
    expect(mockSignOut).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      headers: event.headers,
      returnHeaders: true,
    })
  })

  it('forwards the session-expiry Set-Cookie from signOut', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/logout.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const headers = new Headers()
    headers.append('set-cookie', 'merp-session_token=; Max-Age=0; Path=/')
    mockSignOut.mockResolvedValue({ headers, response: { success: true } })

    const event = {
      context: { session: { id: 'session-123' } },
      headers: new Headers(),
    } as any

    await handler(event)

    expect(mockAppendResponseHeaders).toHaveBeenCalledWith(event, {
      'set-cookie': ['merp-session_token=; Max-Age=0; Path=/'],
    })
  })

  it('returns 401 when no active session exists', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/logout.post').then((m) => m.default)

    const event = {
      context: {},
      headers: new Headers(),
    } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('No active session.')
    expect(mockSignOut).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('returns 401 when session is undefined', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/logout.post').then((m) => m.default)

    const event = {
      context: { session: undefined },
      headers: new Headers(),
    } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('No active session.')
    expect(mockSignOut).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('calls signOut with event headers', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/logout.post').then((m) => m.default)
    mockSignOut.mockResolvedValue({ headers: new Headers(), response: { success: true } })

    const headers = new Headers({ cookie: 'merp-session_token=abc123' })
    const event = {
      context: { session: { id: 'session-123' } },
      headers,
    } as any

    await handler(event)

    expect(mockSignOut).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ headers, returnHeaders: true })
  })

  it('emits session_invalidated event with sessionId on logout', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/logout.post').then((m) => m.default)
    mockSignOut.mockResolvedValue({ headers: new Headers(), response: { success: true } })

    const event = {
      context: {
        session: { id: 'session-123', activeCompanyId: 'company-1' },
        user: { id: 'user-1', email: 'user@example.com' },
      },
      headers: new Headers(),
    } as any

    await handler(event)

    expect(mockCreateAuthEvent).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      userId: 'user-1',
      email: 'user@example.com',
      eventType: 'session_invalidated',
      ipAddress: null,
      metadata: {
        sessionId: 'session-123',
        userId: 'user-1',
        tenantId: 'company-1',
      },
    })
  })

  it('emits session_invalidated with unknown user when context user is missing', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/logout.post').then((m) => m.default)
    mockSignOut.mockResolvedValue({ headers: new Headers(), response: { success: true } })

## FILE: server/api/auth/logout.post.ts

```
import { defineEventHandler, appendResponseHeaders } from 'h3'
import { getAuth } from '#shared/auth'
import type { AuthInstance } from '#shared/auth'
import { logger } from '#shared/logger'
import { sendUnauthorizedError, sendAuthUnavailableError } from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'
import { createAuthEvent } from '~~/server/utils/shared/audit'
import { getClientIp } from '~~/server/utils/shared/ip'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const session = event.context.session as { id: string } | undefined
  const user = event.context.user as { id: string; email: string } | undefined

  if (!session) {
    sendUnauthorizedError('No active session.')
  }

  // FR-025: 503 auth_unavailable se o Better Auth não puder ser resolvido.
  let authInstance: AuthInstance
  try {
    authInstance = await getAuth()
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Better Auth instance unavailable', { error: String(error) })
    sendAuthUnavailableError()
  }

  // signOut expira o cookie de sessão nos response headers do retorno —
  // sem forwarding o cookie morto fica no navegador.
  const result = await authInstance.api.signOut({
    headers: event.headers,
    returnHeaders: true,
  })

  const setCookies = result.headers?.getSetCookie?.() ?? []
  if (setCookies.length > 0) {
    appendResponseHeaders(event, { 'set-cookie': setCookies })
  }

  const ip = getClientIp(event)

  // FR-023: session_invalidated — sessão encerrada pelo logout.
  await createAuthEvent({
    userId: user?.id ?? null,
    email: user?.email ?? 'unknown',
    eventType: 'session_invalidated',
    ipAddress: ip || null,
    metadata: {
      sessionId: session?.id ?? null,
      userId: user?.id ?? null,
      tenantId: (session as any)?.activeCompanyId ?? null,
    },
  })

  if (user) {
    await createAuthEvent({
      userId: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      eventType: 'logout',
      ipAddress: ip || null,
    })
  }

  return { message: 'Logged out successfully' }
})

```
import { defineEventHandler, createError } from 'h3'
import { companyRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const user = event.context.user as
    | {
        id: string
        email: string
        name: string | null
      }
    | undefined
  const currentSession = event.context.session as { id: string } | undefined

  if (!user) {
    throw createError({
      status: 401,
      statusText: 'Unauthorized',
      message: JSON.stringify({
        error: 'unauthorized',
        message: 'Authentication required.',
      }),
    })
  }

  const [companies, activeCompanyId] = await Promise.all([
    companyRepository.findUserCompanies(user.id),
    currentSession ? companyRepository.getActiveCompany(currentSession.id) : Promise.resolve(null),
  ])

  return {
    id: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    name: user.name || null,
    activeCompanyId,
    companies: companies.map((c) => ({
      id: c.id,
      name: c.name,
      role: c.role,
    })),
  }
})

## FILE: server/api/auth/register.post.ts

```
import { defineEventHandler, readBody, setResponseStatus } from 'h3'
import { identityRepository, generateUserId } from '~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository'
import {
  checkEmailRateLimit,
  checkIpRateLimit,
  EMAIL_REGEX,
  MAX_CONSENT_VERSION_LENGTH,
  MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH,
  MAX_NAME_LENGTH,
  MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH,
  normalizeEmail,
  isWeakPassword,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/security'
import { checkPasswordBreach } from '~~/server/utils/shared/hibp'
import { sendValidationError } from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'
import { createAuthEvent } from '~~/server/utils/shared/audit'
import { getClientIp } from '~~/server/utils/shared/ip'

export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  await checkIpRateLimit(event)

  const body = await readBody<{
    email?: string
    password?: string
    name?: string
    consentTermsVersion?: string
  }>(event)

  const email = typeof body?.email === 'string' ? normalizeEmail(body.email) : ''

  // AUD-22: EMAIL_REGEX (compartilhado) — includes('@') aceitava 'a@b'.
  if (!email || !EMAIL_REGEX.test(email)) {
    sendValidationError('Valid email is required')
  }

  // AUD-14: tetos de tamanho — sem eles, emails/names gigantes viram colunas
  // de PII desproporcionais e senhas de megabytes custam scrypt desmedido
  // (o better-auth hasheia antes de validar qualquer coisa).
  if (email.length > MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH) {
    sendValidationError('Valid email is required')
  }

  if (!body?.password || typeof body.password !== 'string' || body.password.length < 8) {
    sendValidationError('Password must be at least 8 characters')
  }

  if (body.password.length > MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH) {
    sendValidationError('Password must be at most 128 characters')
  }

  if (isWeakPassword(body.password)) {
    sendValidationError('Password is too common. Choose a stronger password.')
  }

  // NIST 800-63B: check against breached passwords (HIBP k-anonymity)
  const breach = await checkPasswordBreach(body.password)
  if (breach.breached) {
    sendValidationError(
      'This password has appeared in data breaches. Please choose a different password.',
    )
  }

  if (!body?.name || typeof body.name !== 'string' || body.name.trim().length === 0) {
    sendValidationError('Name is required')
  }

  if (body.name.trim().length > MAX_NAME_LENGTH) {
    sendValidationError('Name must be at most 120 characters')
  }

  // AUD-13: consentimento é a base legal do registro (LGPD) — a conta não
  // pode existir sem a versão dos termos aceita gravada.
  if (
    !body?.consentTermsVersion ||
    typeof body.consentTermsVersion !== 'string' ||
    body.consentTermsVersion.trim().length === 0
  ) {
    sendValidationError('consentTermsVersion is required')
  }

  // AUD-14: versão de termos é identificador curto — teto evita coluna gigante.
  if (body.consentTermsVersion.trim().length > MAX_CONSENT_VERSION_LENGTH) {
    sendValidationError('consentTermsVersion must be at most 50 characters')
  }

  await checkEmailRateLimit(event, email)

  const user = await identityRepository.register({
    email,
    password: body.password,
    name: body.name.trim(),
    consentTermsVersion: body.consentTermsVersion.trim(),
  })

  if (user) {
    const ip = getClientIp(event)
    await createAuthEvent({
      userId: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      eventType: 'registration',
      ipAddress: ip || null,
    })
  }

  // AUD-03: resposta genérica idêntica para email novo e já registrado —
  // mesmo status, corpo derivado do input e timing igualado pelo
  // better-auth (hash de senha em ambos os caminhos).
  setResponseStatus(event, 201)
  return {
    id: user?.id ?? generateUserId(),
    email: user?.email ?? email,
    name: user?.name ?? body.name.trim(),
    createdAt: user?.createdAt ?? new Date(),
  }
})

```
import { defineEventHandler, getQuery, readBody } from 'h3'
import { identityRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository'
import {
  checkIpRateLimit,
  isWeakPassword,
  MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/security'
import { checkPasswordBreach } from '~~/server/utils/shared/hibp'
import { sendValidationError } from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'

// AUD-04: define a nova senha com o token de reset (uso único, TTL 1h).
// Todas as sessões do usuário são revogadas (revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset).
// Token aceito via body ou query — o cliente oficial do better-auth envia
// nos dois lugares.
export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  await checkIpRateLimit(event)

  const body = await readBody<{ token?: string; newPassword?: string }>(event)

  if (!body?.newPassword || typeof body.newPassword !== 'string' || body.newPassword.length < 8) {
    sendValidationError('Password must be at least 8 characters')
  }

  // AUD-14: teto superior — senha de megabytes custaria scrypt desproporcional
  // no reset (mesmo limite do register/login).
  if (body.newPassword.length > MAX_PASSWORD_LENGTH) {
    sendValidationError('Password must be at most 128 characters')
  }

  if (isWeakPassword(body.newPassword)) {
    sendValidationError('Password is too common. Choose a stronger password.')
  }

  // NIST 800-63B: check against breached passwords (HIBP k-anonymity)
  const breach = await checkPasswordBreach(body.newPassword)
  if (breach.breached) {
    sendValidationError(
      'This password has appeared in data breaches. Please choose a different password.',
    )
  }

  const token = typeof body?.token === 'string' && body.token ? body.token : getQuery(event).token
  if (typeof token !== 'string' || !token) {
    sendValidationError('Invalid or expired reset link')
  }

  await identityRepository.resetPassword(token, body.newPassword)

  return { status: true }
})

```
import { defineEventHandler, getRouterParam, sendRedirect } from 'h3'
import { identityRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository'
import { checkIpRateLimit } from '~~/server/utils/shared/security'

// AUD-04/AUD-08: clique no link de reset enviado por email. Valida o token
// (sem consumir — o consumo único acontece no POST /reset-password) e
// redireciona para a origem do app (BETTER_AUTH_URL) com o token no
// FRAGMENTO de hash (#/reset-password?token=...) — fragment nunca é enviado
// ao servidor, não entra em logs (nginx/app/proxies) nem em Referer; só fica
// no address bar do navegador (limpo pelo app.vue). O destino do redirect é
// derivado SÓ de config de servidor — o callbackURL da query é ignorado por
// completo (anti-open-redirect AUD-08): o email é gerado server-side com
// redirectTo=baseURL, então input do usuário nunca influencia o destino.
export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  await checkIpRateLimit(event)

  const token = getRouterParam(event, 'token')
  const appOrigin = new URL(process.env.BETTER_AUTH_URL || 'http://localhost:3000').origin

  const valid =
    typeof token === 'string' && token ? await identityRepository.validateResetToken(token) : false

  await sendRedirect(
    event,
    valid
      ? `${appOrigin}/#/reset-password?token=${encodeURIComponent(token!)}`
      : `${appOrigin}/?error=INVALID_TOKEN`,
    302,
  )
})

```
import { defineEventHandler, readBody } from 'h3'
import { identityRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository'
import {
  checkEmailRateLimit,
  checkIpRateLimit,
  EMAIL_REGEX,
  MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH,
  normalizeEmail,
} from '~~/server/utils/shared/security'
import { sendValidationError } from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'

// AUD-04: reenvio do link de verificação de email. Resposta genérica
// {status:true} para qualquer email (existente ou não) — anti-enumeração:
// o better-auth mantém piso de 500ms e resposta idêntica; o envio real só
// acontece para conta existente e não-verificada.
export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  await checkIpRateLimit(event)

  const body = await readBody<{ email?: string }>(event)

  const email = typeof body?.email === 'string' ? normalizeEmail(body.email) : ''
  if (!email || !EMAIL_REGEX.test(email)) {
    sendValidationError('Valid email is required')
  }

  // AUD-14: teto antes do checkEmailRateLimit — email gigante não vira chave.
  if (email.length > MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH) {
    sendValidationError('Valid email is required')
  }

  await checkEmailRateLimit(event, email)

  await identityRepository.sendVerificationEmail(email)

  return { status: true }
})

import { defineEventHandler, getQuery } from 'h3'
import { identityRepository } from '~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository'
import { checkIpRateLimit } from '~~/server/utils/shared/security'
import { sendValidationError } from '~~/server/utils/shared/errors'

// AUD-04: destino do link de verificação de email (GET — convenção de links
// de email; o token é um JWT assinado com TTL de 1h). Idempotente: verificar
// email já verificado responde sucesso normalmente.
export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  await checkIpRateLimit(event)

  const { token } = getQuery(event)
  if (typeof token !== 'string' || !token) {
    sendValidationError('Invalid or expired verification link')
  }

  await identityRepository.verifyEmail(token)

  return { status: true }
})

import { defineEventHandler, setResponseHeaders } from 'h3'

export default defineEventHandler((event) => {
  setResponseHeaders(event, {
    'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
    'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=86400',
  })

Contact: https://${domain}/security-contact

Canonical: https://${domain}/.well-known/security.txt
Policy: https://${domain}/security-policy

## FILE: server/tasks/purge-auth-events.ts

```
import { db } from '~~/server/utils/db'
import { authEvent } from '~~/server/utils/schema'
import { lt } from 'drizzle-orm'
import { runPurgeTask } from '~~/server/utils/shared/purge'

const RETENTION_DAYS = 90

export default defineTask({
  meta: {
    name: 'purge-auth-events',
    description: 'Purge auth events older than the retention window (PII retention)',
  },
  async run() {
    return runPurgeTask({
      retentionMs: RETENTION_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
      eventPrefix: 'auth_event_purge',
      startLog: 'purging_stale_auth_events',
      completeLog: 'stale_auth_events_purged',
      errorLog: 'auth_event_purge_failed',
      remove: async (cutoff) =>
        (await db.delete(authEvent).where(lt(authEvent.createdAt, cutoff))).count ?? 0,
    })
  },
})

import { db } from '~~/server/utils/db'
import { session } from '~~/server/utils/schema'
import { lt } from 'drizzle-orm'
import { runPurgeTask } from '~~/server/utils/shared/purge'

const GRACE_PERIOD_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000

export default defineTask({
  meta: {
    name: 'purge-sessions',
    description: 'Purge expired sessions past TTL + 24h grace period',
  },
  async run() {
    return runPurgeTask({
      retentionMs: GRACE_PERIOD_MS,
      eventPrefix: 'session_purge',
      startLog: 'purging_expired_sessions',
      completeLog: 'expired_sessions_purged',
      errorLog: 'session_purge_failed',
      remove: async (cutoff) =>
        (await db.delete(session).where(lt(session.expiresAt, cutoff))).count ?? 0,
    })
  },
})

## FILE: server/utils/00-rls-canary.test.ts

```
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { db, createOwnerDbForSetupOnly } from './db'
import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm'

const dbAvailable = process.env.DB_AVAILABLE === 'true'

describe.skipIf(!dbAvailable)('RLS Canary — MUST fail if suite runs as owner/superuser', () => {
  const ownerDb = createOwnerDbForSetupOnly()

  it('prevents cross-tenant read: tenant A cannot read tenant B data', async () => {
    const companyA = 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa'
    const companyB = 'bbbbbbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb'
    const userA = 'uuuuuuuu-uuuu-uuuu-uuuu-uuuuuuuuuuuu'

    // Setup: create two companies and a user member of company A only (as owner, bypasses RLS)
    await ownerDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(
        sql`INSERT INTO company (id, name) VALUES (${companyA}, 'Company A') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
      )
      await tx.execute(
        sql`INSERT INTO company (id, name) VALUES (${companyB}, 'Company B') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
      )
      await tx.execute(
        sql`INSERT INTO "user" (id, email, name) VALUES (${userA}, 'userA@test.com', 'User A') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
      )
      await tx.execute(sql`
        INSERT INTO company_member (company_id, user_id, role)
        VALUES (${companyA}, ${userA}, 'member')
        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
      `)
    })

    // ACT: connect as merp_app (RLS enforced), set tenant to company A
    // Try to read company B — MUST return 0 rows
    const result = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', ${companyA}, true)`)
      await tx.execute(sql`SELECT set_config('app.user_id', ${userA}, true)`)

      const [row] = await tx.execute(sql`SELECT * FROM company WHERE id = ${companyB}`)
      return row
    })

    // ASSERT: RLS must block cross-tenant access
    if (result !== undefined) {
      throw new Error('RLS BYPASS DETECTED — suite is running as owner/superuser')
    }
  })

  it('prevents cross-tenant read via company_member table', async () => {
    const companyA = 'cccccccc-cccc-cccc-cccc-cccccccccccc'
    const companyB = 'dddddddd-dddd-dddd-dddd-dddddddddddd'
    const userA = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee'

    await ownerDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(
        sql`INSERT INTO company (id, name) VALUES (${companyA}, 'Company C') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
      )
      await tx.execute(
        sql`INSERT INTO company (id, name) VALUES (${companyB}, 'Company D') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
      )
      await tx.execute(
        sql`INSERT INTO "user" (id, email, name) VALUES (${userA}, 'userB@test.com', 'User B') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
      )
      await tx.execute(sql`
        INSERT INTO company_member (company_id, user_id, role)
        VALUES (${companyA}, ${userA}, 'member')
        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
      `)
    })

    // Set tenant to company A, try to read company_member rows for company B
    const count = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', ${companyA}, true)`)
      await tx.execute(sql`SELECT set_config('app.user_id', ${userA}, true)`)

      const [row] = await tx.execute(
        sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company_member WHERE company_id = ${companyB}`,
      )
      return Number((row as any).count)
    })

    if (count > 0) {
      throw new Error('RLS BYPASS DETECTED — suite is running as owner/superuser')
    }
  })
})

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { escapeLikePattern } from './repository'

describe('escapeLikePattern', () => {
  it('escapes % wildcards', () => {
    expect(escapeLikePattern('50%')).toBe('50\\%')
    expect(escapeLikePattern('%%')).toBe('\\%\\%')
  })

  it('escapes _ wildcards', () => {
    expect(escapeLikePattern('_a')).toBe('\\_a')
  })

  it('escapes backslashes', () => {
    expect(escapeLikePattern('a\\b')).toBe('a\\\\b')
  })

  it('leaves plain strings untouched', () => {
    expect(escapeLikePattern('acme')).toBe('acme')
  })
})

import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll } from 'vitest'

const INTEGRATION_DB_URL = 'postgres://merp_app:merp_app@localhost:5432/merp_test'

const dbAvailable = process.env.DB_AVAILABLE === 'true'

describe.skipIf(!dbAvailable)('CompanyRepository (integration)', () => {
  let repo: any
  let identity: any

  beforeAll(async () => {
    process.env.APP_DATABASE_URL = INTEGRATION_DB_URL
    repo = new (await import('~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository')).CompanyRepository()
    identity = new (await import('~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository')).IdentityRepository()
  })

  const registerUser = (email: string, name: string) =>
    identity.register({ email, password: 'password123', name })

  describe('RLS isolation', () => {
    it('prevents cross-tenant member visibility', async () => {
      const emailA = `tenant-a-${Date.now()}@example.com`
      const emailB = `tenant-b-${Date.now()}@example.com`

      const userA = await registerUser(emailA, 'User A')
      const userB = await registerUser(emailB, 'User B')

      const companyA = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Company A' }, userA.id)
      const companyB = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Company B' }, userB.id)

      const userACompanies = await repo.findUserCompanies(userA.id)
      expect(userACompanies).toHaveLength(1)
      expect(userACompanies[0].id).toBe(companyA.id)

      const userBCompanies = await repo.findUserCompanies(userB.id)
      expect(userBCompanies).toHaveLength(1)
      expect(userBCompanies[0].id).toBe(companyB.id)
    })

    it('prevents cross-tenant SELECT without tenant context (fail-closed 0 rows)', async () => {
      const emailA = `iso-select-a-${Date.now()}@example.com`
      const emailB = `iso-select-b-${Date.now()}@example.com`

      const userA = await registerUser(emailA, 'Sel A')
      const userB = await registerUser(emailB, 'Sel B')

      const companyA = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Sel Company A' }, userA.id)
      const companyB = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Sel Company B' }, userB.id)

      const { withTenant } = await import('~~/server/utils/auth/tenant-context')
      const { companyMember } = await import('~~/server/utils/schema')
      const { eq } = await import('drizzle-orm')

      // cm_select_policy confia no tenant context (fornecido pelo app, não pelo
      // atacante) — sem contexto, user A não vê nada da empresa B (fail-closed).
      const rows = await withTenant(null, userA.id, (tx) =>
        tx.select().from(companyMember).where(eq(companyMember.companyId, companyB.id)),
      )

      expect(rows).toHaveLength(0)
    })

    it('prevents cross-tenant UPDATE on company via raw SQL (0 rows)', async () => {
      const emailA = `iso-update-a-${Date.now()}@example.com`
      const emailB = `iso-update-b-${Date.now()}@example.com`

      const userA = await registerUser(emailA, 'Upd A')
      const userB = await registerUser(emailB, 'Upd B')

      const companyA = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Upd Company A' }, userA.id)
      const companyB = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Upd Company B' }, userB.id)

      const { withTenant } = await import('~~/server/utils/auth/tenant-context')
      const { company } = await import('~~/server/utils/schema')
      const { eq } = await import('drizzle-orm')

      const updated = await withTenant(companyB.id, userA.id, (tx) =>
        tx.update(company).set({ name: 'Hacked' }).where(eq(company.id, companyB.id)).returning(),
      )

      expect(updated).toHaveLength(0)
      expect(await repo.findCompanyById(companyB.id, userB.id)).toMatchObject({
        name: 'Upd Company B',
      })
    })

    it('AUD-20: an outsider cannot read a company by id (0 rows → null)', async () => {
      const emailA = `iso-find-a-${Date.now()}@example.com`
      const emailB = `iso-find-b-${Date.now()}@example.com`

      const userA = await registerUser(emailA, 'Find A')
      const userB = await registerUser(emailB, 'Find B')

      const companyB = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Find Company B' }, userB.id)

      expect(await repo.findCompanyById(companyB.id, userA.id)).toBeNull()
      expect(await repo.findCompanyById(companyB.id, userB.id)).toMatchObject({
        id: companyB.id,
      })
    })

    it('AUD-10: search is scoped to the user membership', async () => {
      const member = await registerUser(`scope-member-${Date.now()}@example.com`, 'Scope Member')
      const outsider = await registerUser(`scope-outsider-${Date.now()}@example.com`, 'Scope Out')

      const mine = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Scope Mine Company' }, member.id)
      const theirs = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner(
        { name: 'Scope Theirs Company' },
        outsider.id,
      )

      const memberResults = await repo.searchCompanies('Scope', member.id)
      expect(memberResults.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual([mine.id])
      expect(memberResults.some((c) => c.id === theirs.id)).toBe(false)

      const outsiderResults = await repo.searchCompanies('Scope', outsider.id)
      expect(outsiderResults.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual([theirs.id])
      expect(outsiderResults.some((c) => c.id === mine.id)).toBe(false)
    })
  })

  describe('createCompanyWithOwner', () => {
    it('creates company and owner atomically', async () => {
      const owner = await registerUser(`atomic-owner-${Date.now()}@example.com`, 'Atomic Owner')

      const company = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Atomic Company' }, owner.id)

      expect(company).toMatchObject({ name: 'Atomic Company', isDeleted: false })
      expect(await repo.getCompanyMembershipRole(owner.id, company.id)).toBe('owner')
    })

    it('rolls back company creation when owner insert fails', async () => {
      const name = `Atomic Fail ${Date.now()}`
      const searcher = await registerUser(
        `atomic-search-${Date.now()}@example.com`,
        'Atomic Searcher',
      )

      await expect(repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name }, 'nonexistent-user-id')).rejects.toThrow()

      const results = await repo.searchCompanies('Atomic Fail', searcher.id)
      expect(results.some((c: any) => c.name === name)).toBe(false)
    })
  })

  describe('company membership roles', () => {
    it('returns the role of a member and null for non-members', async () => {
      const email = `role-${Date.now()}@example.com`
      const user = await registerUser(email, 'Role User')

      const memberA = await registerUser(`blk-member-a-${Date.now()}@example.com`, 'Blk Member A')
