## FILE: server/utils/auth/company/repository.ts

```
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
import { and, eq, like, or, sql } from 'drizzle-orm'
import { db } from '../../db'
import { company, companyMember, session } from '../../schema'
import { createError, H3Error } from 'h3'
import {
  handleDatabaseError,
  sendConflictError,
  sendForbiddenError,
  sendNotFoundError,
  isPgConflict,
} from '../../shared/errors'
import { withTenant } from '../tenant-context'

export function escapeLikePattern(query: string): string {
  return query.replace(/[\\%_]/g, (c) => `\\${c}`)
}

export interface CreateCompanyInput {
  name: string
  cnpj?: string
  razaoSocial?: string
}

export interface CompanyResult {
  id: string
  name: string
  cnpj: string | null
  razaoSocial: string | null
  isDeleted: boolean
  createdAt: Date
  updatedAt: Date
}

export interface CompanyMemberResult {
  id: string
  companyId: string
  userId: string
  role: string
  createdAt: Date
}

/** Tenant/membership repository — every query runs under {@link withTenant} (RLS backstop). */
export class CompanyRepository {
  /**
   * Creates a company row without members (low-level; prefer
   * {@link createCompanyWithOwner}). 409 when the CNPJ is taken.
   */
  async createCompany(input: CreateCompanyInput): Promise<CompanyResult> {
    try {
      // AUD-20: company_select_policy agora exige membership OU tenant em
      // contexto — o INSERT...RETURNING precisa do GUC de tenant já setado
      // (id = get_tenant_id()), senão a row retornada é filtrada (0 rows).
      // O id é gerado no app e o tenant GUC aponta para ele antes do insert.
      const companyId = randomUUID()
      return await withTenant(companyId, null, async (tx) => {
        const [created] = await tx
          .insert(company)
          .values({
            id: companyId,
            name: input.name,
            cnpj: input.cnpj || null,
            razaoSocial: input.razaoSocial || null,
          })
          .returning()

        return created!
      })
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (isPgConflict(error)) {
        throw createError({
          status: 409,
          statusText: '409',
          message: JSON.stringify({
            error: 'conflict',
            message: 'CNPJ already registered',
          }),
        })
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Creates a company and its first member (`owner`) in one transaction
   * (founder bootstrap). 409 when the CNPJ is taken.
   */
  async createCompanyWithOwner(
    data: CreateCompanyInput,
    ownerUserId: string,
  ): Promise<CompanyResult> {
    try {
      // AUD-20: o INSERT de company precisa do tenant GUC setado ANTES do
      // insert (policy: id = get_tenant_id()) — o id agora é gerado no app e
      // o withTenant envolve todo o fluxo (company + member) na transação.
      return await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        const companyId = randomUUID()
        const created = await withTenant(
          companyId,
          ownerUserId,
          async (ctxTx) => {
            // AUD-01/AUD-11: cm_insert_policy (0014) só permite self-insert
            // role='owner' com este flag (bootstrap do fundador); role='member'
            // exige o flag de member (createCompanyMember) ou token de convite.
            await ctxTx.execute(sql`SELECT set_config('app.allow_founder_bootstrap', 'true', true)`)
            const [row] = await ctxTx
              .insert(company)
              .values({
                id: companyId,
                name: data.name,
                cnpj: data.cnpj,
                razaoSocial: data.razaoSocial,
              })
              .returning()
            await ctxTx
              .insert(companyMember)
              .values({ companyId, userId: ownerUserId, role: 'owner' })
            return row!
          },
          tx,
        )

        return created
      })
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (isPgConflict(error)) {
        throw createError({
          status: 409,
          statusText: '409',
          message: JSON.stringify({
            error: 'conflict',
            message: 'CNPJ already registered',
          }),
        })
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Self-adds a user as `member` (test fixtures / future self-join flows).
   * `role` must be `"member"` — owner bootstrap uses
   * {@link createCompanyWithOwner}; invite acceptance never uses this method.
   * 409 when the membership already exists.
   */
  async createCompanyMember(
    companyId: string,
    userId: string,
    role = 'member',
  ): Promise<CompanyMemberResult> {
    // AUD-11: este método é bootstrap de MEMBRO (fixtures de teste e futuros
    // fluxos que se auto-adicionam como member). Criar owner exige o caminho
    // de founder (createCompanyWithOwner): a policy 0014 nega role='owner'
    // com o flag de member — e este guard falha cedo com erro claro em vez
    // de 42501 opaco. Adicionar OUTRO usuário é o branch is_company_owner
    // da policy (owner adiciona qualquer membro) — nunca este método.
    // Guard antes do try/catch: é erro de programação, não 503 de serviço.
    if (role !== 'member') {
      throw new Error(
        'createCompanyMember: role must be "member"; owner bootstrap uses createCompanyWithOwner',
      )
    }
    try {
      return await withTenant(companyId, userId, async (tx) => {
        // AUD-01/AUD-11: caminho confiado de inserção de member (fixtures de
        // teste e futuros fluxos de gestão) — marca o tx como bootstrap de
        // member; caminhos de aceite de convite NÃO usam este método (exigem
        // token). O flag não habilita role='owner' (0014).
        await tx.execute(sql`SELECT set_config('app.allow_member_bootstrap', 'true', true)`)
        const [created] = await tx
          .insert(companyMember)
          .values({ companyId, userId, role })
          .returning()
        return created!
      })
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (isPgConflict(error)) {
        throw createError({
          status: 409,
          statusText: '409',
          message: JSON.stringify({
            error: 'conflict',
            message: 'User is already a member of this company',
          }),
        })
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  // AUD-10: busca escopada por vínculo — apenas empresas onde o usuário é
  // member aparecem (antes: qualquer autenticado enumerava nome+CNPJ de tudo).
  // O join roda com withTenant(null, userId): a cm_select_policy (0005) só
  // expõe linhas de company_member com user_id = get_user_id().
  /**
   * Searches non-deleted companies the user belongs to (max 20, LIKE on
   * name/CNPJ with escaped wildcards).
   */
  async searchCompanies(query: string, userId: string): Promise<CompanyResult[]> {
    try {
      const pattern = `%${escapeLikePattern(query)}%`
      return await withTenant(null, userId, async (tx) => {
        return await tx
          .select({
            id: company.id,
            name: company.name,
            cnpj: company.cnpj,
            razaoSocial: company.razaoSocial,
            isDeleted: company.isDeleted,
            createdAt: company.createdAt,
            updatedAt: company.updatedAt,
          })
          .from(companyMember)
          .innerJoin(company, eq(companyMember.companyId, company.id))
          .where(
            and(
              eq(companyMember.userId, userId),
              eq(company.isDeleted, false),
              or(like(company.name, pattern), like(company.cnpj, pattern)),
            ),
          )
          .limit(20)
      })
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  // AUD-20: rodar com withTenant(null, userId) — o tenant GUC fica vazio e a
  // company_select_policy (0016) exige membership real (EXISTS em
  // company_member com get_user_id()). Outsider → 0 rows → null (404 nos
  // handlers), mesmo sem check explícito no app.
  /** Finds a non-deleted company visible to the user, or null (RLS outsiders get null). */
  async findCompanyById(id: string, userId: string): Promise<CompanyResult | null> {
    try {
      return await withTenant(null, userId, async (tx) => {
        const [found] = await tx
          .select()
          .from(company)
          .where(and(eq(company.id, id), eq(company.isDeleted, false)))
          .limit(1)

        return found || null
      })
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Lists non-deleted companies the user belongs to, each with its membership role. */
  async findUserCompanies(userId: string): Promise<Array<CompanyResult & { role: string }>> {
    try {
      return await withTenant(null, userId, async (tx) => {
        return await tx
          .select({
            id: company.id,
            name: company.name,
            cnpj: company.cnpj,
            razaoSocial: company.razaoSocial,
            isDeleted: company.isDeleted,
            createdAt: company.createdAt,
            updatedAt: company.updatedAt,
            role: companyMember.role,
          })
          .from(companyMember)
          .innerJoin(company, eq(companyMember.companyId, company.id))
          .where(and(eq(companyMember.userId, userId), eq(company.isDeleted, false)))
      })
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** True when the user is a member of the company. */
  async isCompanyMember(userId: string, companyId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      return await withTenant(companyId, userId, async (tx) => {
        const [found] = await tx
          .select({ id: companyMember.id })
          .from(companyMember)
          .where(and(eq(companyMember.userId, userId), eq(companyMember.companyId, companyId)))
          .limit(1)
        return !!found
      })
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Returns the membership role (`owner`|`member`) or null for non-members. */
  async getCompanyMembershipRole(userId: string, companyId: string): Promise<string | null> {
    try {
      return await withTenant(companyId, userId, async (tx) => {
        const [found] = await tx
          .select({ role: companyMember.role })
          .from(companyMember)
          .where(and(eq(companyMember.userId, userId), eq(companyMember.companyId, companyId)))
          .limit(1)
        return found?.role ?? null
      })
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Removes a member. `executedByUserId` drives the RLS authorization
   * (owner removes anyone; a member removes only itself) — never pass the
   * target as executor. Detaches the removed user's sessions from the
   * company. 404 when RLS denies or the membership does not exist.
   */
  async removeCompanyMember(
    companyId: string,
    executedByUserId: string,
    targetUserId: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      // executedByUserId define app.user_id: cm_delete_policy (0010) só permite
      // (a) owner remover qualquer member ou (b) o próprio member (não owner)
      // sair. Passar o target como "executor" faria o backstop RLS avaliar a
      // autorização do alvo — nunca fazer isso (mesmo desvio do prompt 20).
      return await withTenant(companyId, executedByUserId, async (tx) => {
        const deleted = await tx
          .delete(companyMember)
          .where(
            and(eq(companyMember.companyId, companyId), eq(companyMember.userId, targetUserId)),
          )
          .returning({ id: companyMember.id })

        if (deleted.length === 0) {
          sendNotFoundError('Company member not found') // RLS negou ou não é membro (0 rows)
        }

        // Sessões do removido não podem continuar apontando para a empresa
        // (context.tenantId no middleware vem de activeCompanyId).
        await tx
          .update(session)
          .set({ activeCompanyId: null, updatedAt: new Date() })
          .where(and(eq(session.userId, targetUserId), eq(session.activeCompanyId, companyId)))
      })
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof H3Error) {
        throw error
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Points a session at a company (`null` clears it). Membership is
   * re-validated in the same transaction (TOCTOU-safe). 403 for non-members.
   */
  async setActiveCompany(
    sessionId: string,
    companyId: string | null,
    userId: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await withTenant(companyId, userId, async (tx) => {
        if (companyId !== null) {
          // AUD-13: revalidação de filiação NA MESMA transação do write —
          // o check no handler (empresas.switch.post.ts) roda em transação
          // separada: um owner poderia remover o membro na janela entre o
          // check e o update, deixando activeCompanyId apontando para uma
          // empresa onde o usuário não é mais membro (contexto de tenant
          // que satisfaz as policies RLS por get_tenant_id()).
          const [membership] = await tx
            .select({ id: companyMember.id })
            .from(companyMember)
            .where(and(eq(companyMember.companyId, companyId), eq(companyMember.userId, userId)))
            .limit(1)

          if (!membership) {
            sendForbiddenError('User is not a member of the specified company')
          }
        }

        await tx
          .update(session)
          .set({ activeCompanyId: companyId, updatedAt: new Date() })
          .where(eq(session.id, sessionId))
      })
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof H3Error) {
        throw error
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Returns the session's active company id, or null. */
  async getActiveCompany(sessionId: string): Promise<string | null> {
    try {
      const [found] = await db
        .select({ activeCompanyId: session.activeCompanyId })
        .from(session)
        .where(eq(session.id, sessionId))
        .limit(1)

      return found?.activeCompanyId || null
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Soft-deletes a company: flags `is_deleted`, purges memberships and
   * detaches sessions pointing at it. 404 when RLS denies or already deleted.
   */
  async softDeleteCompany(companyId: string, userId: string): Promise<CompanyResult> {
    try {
      return await withTenant(companyId, userId, async (tx) => {
        // ATENÇÃO à ordem: update em company ANTES do delete de members —
        // a policy company_modify_policy exige is_company_owner(id) na execução,
        // e o owner ainda é membro neste ponto; deletar members primeiro faria
        // o check falhar (owner removido) → 0 rows → 404 espúrio.
        const [updated] = await tx
          .update(company)
          .set({ isDeleted: true, updatedAt: new Date() })
          .where(eq(company.id, companyId))
          .returning()
        if (!updated) {
          sendNotFoundError('Company not found') // RLS negou ou já deletada (0 rows)
        }
        await tx.delete(companyMember).where(eq(companyMember.companyId, companyId))

        // AUD-13: ex-membros não podem continuar com activeCompanyId na
        // empresa deletada — context.tenantId do middleware viria de uma
        // empresa morta (mesmo gap que removeCompanyMember já cobria).
        await tx
          .update(session)
          .set({ activeCompanyId: null, updatedAt: new Date() })
          .where(eq(session.activeCompanyId, companyId))

        return updated!
      })
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof H3Error) {
        throw error
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Partially updates a company (only defined fields; empty cnpj/razaoSocial
   * clears the column). 404 when RLS denies or the company is deleted;
   * 409 on duplicate CNPJ.
   */
  async updateCompany(
    companyId: string,
    userId: string,
    input: Partial<CreateCompanyInput>,
  ): Promise<CompanyResult> {
    try {
      // userId é obrigatório: company_modify_policy (0009) exige
      // is_company_owner(id), que usa get_user_id() — com user NULL o
      // UPDATE seria sempre negado (0 rows → 404 espúrio).
      return await withTenant(companyId, userId, async (tx) => {
        const updates: Partial<typeof company.$inferInsert> = { updatedAt: new Date() }
        if (input.name !== undefined) updates.name = input.name
        if (input.cnpj !== undefined) updates.cnpj = input.cnpj || null
        if (input.razaoSocial !== undefined) updates.razaoSocial = input.razaoSocial || null

        const [updated] = await tx
          .update(company)
          .set(updates)
          .where(and(eq(company.id, companyId), eq(company.isDeleted, false)))
          .returning()

        if (!updated) {
          sendNotFoundError('Company not found') // RLS negou ou inexistente (0 rows)
        }
        return updated!
      })
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (isPgConflict(error)) {
        sendConflictError('CNPJ already registered')
      }
      if (error instanceof H3Error) {
        throw error
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }
}

export const companyRepository = new CompanyRepository()

import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, vi } from 'vitest'

const INTEGRATION_DB_URL = 'postgres://merp_app:merp_app@localhost:5432/merp_test'
const testEmail = `test-${Date.now()}@example.com`
const testPassword = 'test-password-123'

// AUD-04: os envios de email são mockados — capturamos os links (e tokens)
// gerados pelo better-auth para exercitar o fluxo real de verificação/reset
// contra o banco. O mock é registrado antes de qualquer import de
// shared/auth (getAuth) via hoisting do vi.mock.
const capturedVerificationLinks: Array<{ email: string; link: string }> = []
const capturedResetLinks: Array<{ email: string; link: string }> = []

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/email', async (importOriginal) => {
  const original = await importOriginal<typeof import('~~/server/utils/shared/email')>()
  return {
    ...original,
    sendVerificationEmailLink: async (email: string, link: string) => {
      capturedVerificationLinks.push({ email, link })
    },
    sendPasswordResetLink: async (email: string, link: string) => {
      capturedResetLinks.push({ email, link })
    },
  }
})

function linkFor(captured: Array<{ email: string; link: string }>, email: string): string {
  const entry = [...captured].reverse().find((e) => e.email === email)
  if (!entry) throw new Error(`No email captured for ${email}`)
  return entry.link
}

function tokenFromLink(link: string): string {
  const token = new URL(link).searchParams.get('token')
  if (!token) throw new Error(`No token in link: ${link}`)
  return token
}

function resetTokenFromLink(link: string): string {
  const match = link.match(/\/reset-password\/([^/?]+)/)
  if (!match) throw new Error(`No reset token in link: ${link}`)
  return match[1]
}

async function verifyEmailLink(link: string): Promise<void> {
  const { getAuth } = await import('#shared/auth')
  const auth = await getAuth()
  await auth.api.verifyEmail({ query: { token: tokenFromLink(link) } })
}

const dbAvailable = process.env.DB_AVAILABLE === 'true'

describe.skipIf(!dbAvailable)('IdentityRepository (integration)', () => {
  let repo: any

  beforeAll(async () => {
    process.env.APP_DATABASE_URL = INTEGRATION_DB_URL
    const mod = await import('~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository')
    repo = new mod.IdentityRepository()
  })

  it('registers a new user and sends a verification email (AUD-04 sendOnSignUp)', async () => {
    const result = await repo.register({
      email: testEmail,
      password: testPassword,
      name: 'Test User',
    })

    expect(result).toMatchObject({
      email: testEmail,
      name: 'Test User',
      isActive: true,
    })
    expect(result.id).toBeTruthy()
    expect(result.createdAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date)

    // O link gerado pelo better-auth foi reescrito para a rota do app.
    const link = linkFor(capturedVerificationLinks, testEmail)
    expect(link).toMatch(/\/api\/auth\/verify-email\?token=/)
  })

  it('AUD-04: blocks login until the email is verified (403 email_not_verified)', async () => {
    const headers = new Headers()

    await expect(
      repo.signIn({ email: testEmail, password: testPassword }, headers),
    ).rejects.toSatisfy(
      (error: any) =>
        error?.statusCode === 403 && JSON.parse(error.message)?.error === 'email_not_verified',
    )
  })

  it('signs in with registered credentials after email verification', async () => {
    await verifyEmailLink(linkFor(capturedVerificationLinks, testEmail))

    const headers = new Headers()
    const result = await repo.signIn({ email: testEmail, password: testPassword }, headers)

    expect(result).toMatchObject({
      email: testEmail,
      name: 'Test User',
      isActive: true,
    })
    expect(result.id).toBeTruthy()
  })

  it('AUD-03: duplicate email registration resolves without 409 and without creating a second account', async () => {
    const email = `dup-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const first = await repo.register({ email, password: testPassword, name: 'First User' })

    const second = await repo.register({
      email,
      password: testPassword,
      name: 'Second User',
      consentTermsVersion: 'v1',
    })

    expect(second).toBeNull()
    const found = await repo.findByEmail(email)
    expect(found?.id).toBe(first.id)
    expect(found?.name).toBe('First User')
    expect(found?.consentTermsVersion).toBeNull()
    expect(found?.consentTermsAcceptedAt).toBeNull()
  })

  it('emits session_created auth event after sign-in (FR-023)', async () => {
    const headers = new Headers()
    const result = await repo.signIn({ email: testEmail, password: testPassword }, headers)

    // session_created é fire-and-forget: aguarda o insert chegar no auth_event.
    const { db } = await import('~~/server/utils/db')
    const { authEvent } = await import('~~/server/utils/schema')
    const { eq } = await import('drizzle-orm')
    const { and } = await import('drizzle-orm')

    let event: any
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 50; attempt++) {
      const [found] = await db
        .select()
        .from(authEvent)
        .where(and(eq(authEvent.userId, result.id), eq(authEvent.eventType, 'session_created')))
        .limit(1)
      if (found) {
        event = found
        break
      }
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50))
    }

    expect(event).toBeTruthy()
    expect(event.email).toBe(testEmail)
    expect(event.metadata).toMatchObject({
      userId: result.id,
      sessionId: expect.any(String),
      tenantId: null,
    })
  })

  it('rejects invalid password with 401', async () => {
    const headers = new Headers()

    await expect(
      repo.signIn({ email: testEmail, password: 'wrong-password' }, headers),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 401 })
  })

  it('rejects non-existent email with 401', async () => {
    const headers = new Headers()

    await expect(
      repo.signIn({ email: 'nonexistent@example.com', password: testPassword }, headers),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 401 })
  })

  it('rejects sign-in for deactivated users with account_deactivated', async () => {
    const email = `deactivated-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const user = await repo.register({
      email,
      password: testPassword,
      name: 'Deactivated User',
    })
    await repo.deactivateUser(user.id)

    const headers = new Headers()

    await expect(repo.signIn({ email, password: testPassword }, headers)).rejects.toSatisfy(
      (error: any) =>
        error?.statusCode === 401 && JSON.parse(error.message)?.error === 'account_deactivated',
    )
  })

  it('AUD-07: sign-in attempt on a deactivated account creates no session', async () => {
    const email = `aud07-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const userRecord = await repo.register({
      email,
      password: testPassword,
      name: 'Aud07 User',
    })
    await repo.deactivateUser(userRecord.id)

    const headers = new Headers()

    await expect(repo.signIn({ email, password: testPassword }, headers)).rejects.toSatisfy(
      (error: any) =>
        error?.statusCode === 401 && JSON.parse(error.message)?.error === 'account_deactivated',
    )

    const { db } = await import('~~/server/utils/db')
    const { session } = await import('~~/server/utils/schema')
    const { eq } = await import('drizzle-orm')

    const rows = await db.select().from(session).where(eq(session.userId, userRecord.id))
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it('finds user by email after registration', async () => {
    const found = await repo.findByEmail(testEmail)

    expect(found).toMatchObject({
      email: testEmail,
      isActive: true,
    })
  })

  describe('consent withdrawal (FR-021)', () => {
    it('deactivates the user, stamps consentWithdrawnAt and ends all sessions', async () => {
      const email = `consent-${Date.now()}@example.com`
      const userRecord = await repo.register({
        email,
        password: testPassword,
        name: 'Consent User',
      })

      const session = await repo.createSession(
        userRecord.id,
        `consent-token-${Date.now()}`,
        new Date(Date.now() + 60_000),
        false,
      )

      const result = await repo.withdrawConsent(userRecord.id)

      expect(result.isActive).toBe(false)
      expect(result.consentWithdrawnAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date)

      const found = await repo.findById(userRecord.id)
      expect(found?.isActive).toBe(false)
      expect(found?.consentWithdrawnAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date)

      const sessions = await repo.getUserSessions(userRecord.id)
      expect(sessions).toHaveLength(0)
      expect(await repo.validateSession(session.token)).toBeNull()
    })

    it('rejects sign-in with account_deactivated after consent withdrawal', async () => {
      const email = `consent-signin-${Date.now()}@example.com`
      const userRecord = await repo.register({
        email,
        password: testPassword,
        name: 'Consent SignIn',
      })

      await repo.withdrawConsent(userRecord.id)

      const headers = new Headers()

      await expect(repo.signIn({ email, password: testPassword }, headers)).rejects.toSatisfy(
        (error: any) =>
          error?.statusCode === 401 && JSON.parse(error.message)?.error === 'account_deactivated',
      )
    })
  })

  describe('AUD-04: password reset flow', () => {
    it('resets the password with a single-use token and revokes all sessions', async () => {
      const email = `aud04-reset-${Date.now()}@example.com`
      const userRecord = await repo.register({
        email,
        password: testPassword,
        name: 'Reset User',
      })
      await verifyEmailLink(linkFor(capturedVerificationLinks, email))

      const existingSession = await repo.createSession(
        userRecord.id,
        `reset-session-${Date.now()}`,
        new Date(Date.now() + 60_000),
        false,
      )

      await repo.requestPasswordReset(email)
      const resetLink = linkFor(capturedResetLinks, email)
      expect(resetLink).toMatch(/\/api\/auth\/reset-password\/[^/?]+\?callbackURL=/)
      const token = resetTokenFromLink(resetLink)

      // Validação do clique do link (GET) — não consome o token.
      expect(await repo.validateResetToken(token)).toBe(true)

      await repo.resetPassword(token, 'brand-new-password-456')

      // Senha antiga rejeitada; nova aceita.
      await expect(
        repo.signIn({ email, password: testPassword }, new Headers()),
      ).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 401 })
      const result = await repo.signIn({ email, password: 'brand-new-password-456' }, new Headers())
      expect(result.email).toBe(email)

      // revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: sessão pré-existente invalidada.
      expect(await repo.validateSession(existingSession.token)).toBeNull()

      // Uso único: replay do token falha.
      await expect(repo.resetPassword(token, 'another-password-789')).rejects.toMatchObject({
        statusCode: 400,
      })
    })

    it('returns generically for unknown emails (anti-enumeration) and captures no link', async () => {
      const ghostEmail = `ghost-${Date.now()}@example.com`

      await expect(repo.requestPasswordReset(ghostEmail)).resolves.toBeUndefined()
      expect(capturedResetLinks.some((e) => e.email === ghostEmail)).toBe(false)
    })

    it('AUD-04: real owner can take over a pre-registered account via reset + verification', async () => {
      const email = `aud04-takeover-${Date.now()}@example.com`
      await repo.register({
        email,
        password: 'attacker-password-1',
        name: 'Pre-registered',
      })

      // O dono real do email pede o reset — sem saber a senha do atacante.
      await repo.requestPasswordReset(email)
      const token = resetTokenFromLink(linkFor(capturedResetLinks, email))
      await repo.resetPassword(token, 'owner-password-999')

      // Login com a senha do dono funciona, mas a conta ainda não está
      // verificada (o link de verificação vai para a caixa do dono).
      await expect(
        repo.signIn({ email, password: 'owner-password-999' }, new Headers()),
      ).rejects.toSatisfy(
        (error: any) =>
          error?.statusCode === 403 && JSON.parse(error.message)?.error === 'email_not_verified',
      )

      // O dono clica no link de verificação (enviado para o próprio email).
      await verifyEmailLink(linkFor(capturedVerificationLinks, email))

      const result = await repo.signIn({ email, password: 'owner-password-999' }, new Headers())
      expect(result.email).toBe(email)
    })
  })

  describe('AUD-04: verification link lifecycle', () => {
    it('verification is idempotent — replaying the link succeeds', async () => {
      const email = `aud04-idem-${Date.now()}@example.com`
      await repo.register({ email, password: testPassword, name: 'Idempotent User' })
      const link = linkFor(capturedVerificationLinks, email)

      await verifyEmailLink(link)
      await verifyEmailLink(link)

      const result = await repo.signIn({ email, password: testPassword }, new Headers())
      expect(result.email).toBe(email)
    })

    it('forged verification tokens are rejected', async () => {
      const { getAuth } = await import('#shared/auth')
      const auth = await getAuth()

      await expect(auth.api.verifyEmail({ query: { token: 'forged-token' } })).rejects.toSatisfy(
        (error: any) => error?.statusCode === 401 || error?.statusCode === 400,
      )
    })
  })

  describe('FR-020: LGPD export event listing', () => {
    it('lists only the user’s own events (excludes other users and user-less rows)', async () => {
      const { createAuthEvent } = await import('~~/server/utils/shared/audit')
      const stamp = Date.now()
      const emailA = `export-a-${stamp}@example.com`
      const emailB = `export-b-${stamp}@example.com`
      const userA = await repo.register({ email: emailA, password: testPassword, name: 'A' })
      const userB = await repo.register({ email: emailB, password: testPassword, name: 'B' })

      await createAuthEvent({ userId: userA.id, email: emailA, eventType: 'login' })
      await createAuthEvent({ userId: userA.id, email: emailA, eventType: 'logout' })
      await createAuthEvent({ userId: userB.id, email: emailB, eventType: 'login' })
      await createAuthEvent({ userId: null, email: emailA, eventType: 'failed_login' })

      const events = await repo.listUserAuthEvents(userA.id)

      expect(events).toHaveLength(2)
      expect(events.map((e: any) => e.eventType).sort()).toEqual(['login', 'logout'])
      for (const e of events) {
        expect(e.id).toBeTruthy()
        expect(e.createdAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date)
      }
    })
  })
})

import { and, desc, eq, gt } from 'drizzle-orm'
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
import { db } from '../../db'
import { getAuth } from '#shared/auth'
import type { AuthInstance } from '#shared/auth'
import { logger } from '#shared/logger'
import { authEvent, user, session, verification } from '../../schema'
import { createError, H3Error } from 'h3'
import {
  handleDatabaseError,
  handleUpstreamTimeout,
  sendAuthUnavailableError,
  sendValidationError,
  TimeoutError,
  withTimeout,
} from '../../shared/errors'
import { withTenant } from '../tenant-context'
import { createAuthEvent } from '../../shared/audit'

export interface RegisterInput {
  email: string
  password: string
  name: string
  consentTermsVersion?: string
}

export interface SignInInput {
  email: string
  password: string
  rememberMe?: boolean
}

// AUD-03: id sintético de 32 chars hex para o caminho de "email já
// registrado" (resposta genérica anti-enumeração) — entropia de 122 bits;
// viés de módulo é irrelevante aqui, então uuid puro basta.
export function generateUserId(): string {
  return randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '')
}

export interface UserResult {
  id: string
  email: string
  name: string | null
  isActive: boolean
  consentWithdrawnAt: Date | null
  createdAt: Date
  updatedAt: Date
}

export interface SessionResult {
  id: string
  userId: string
  token: string
  expiresAt: Date
  rememberMe: boolean
  createdAt: Date
}

export interface SessionWithUser {
  session: SessionResult
  user: UserResult
}

// signInEmail grava o cookie de sessão nos response headers do retorno
// (setSessionCookie). Sem returnHeaders + forwarding, o cookie nunca chega
// ao navegador e nenhuma sessão é estabelecida após o login.
export interface SignInResult extends UserResult {
  setCookie: string[]
}

export interface UpdateUserInput {
  name: string
  isActive: boolean
  consentTermsVersion: string
  consentTermsAcceptedAt: Date
  consentWithdrawnAt: Date
}

// AUD-07: senha-pad do caminho de conta desativada — constante impossível de
// acertar (o verify de scrypt é determinístico), usada para igualar o custo
// de timing do signIn sem jamais criar sessão.
const TIMING_PAD_PASSWORD = '__aud07_timing_pad__'

/** Identity/account repository — Better Auth calls wrapped in 5s timeouts (FR-024) with contract-shaped errors. */
export class IdentityRepository {
  // FR-025: a instância do Better Auth é resolvida de forma lazy; se a
  // inicialização falhar (shared/auth.ts), os endpoints retornam 503
  // auth_unavailable em vez de crashar no import.
  private async resolveAuth(): Promise<AuthInstance> {
    try {
      return await getAuth()
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to resolve Better Auth instance', { error: String(error) })
      sendAuthUnavailableError()
    }
  }

  // FR-024: chamadas OAuth futuras (auth.api.signInOAuth etc.) devem usar
  // withTimeout(..., 10_000) — nenhum provider OAuth está configurado ainda.
  /**
   * Registers a user (no session — FR-001) and stamps LGPD consent.
   * Returns null for duplicate emails (anti-enumeration, AUD-03) — never 409.
   */
  async register(input: RegisterInput): Promise<UserResult | null> {
    try {
      const authInstance = await this.resolveAuth()
      const { user: createdUser } = await withTimeout(
        authInstance.api.signUpEmail({
          body: {
            email: input.email,
            password: input.password,
            name: input.name,
            consentTermsVersion: input.consentTermsVersion,
          } as any,
        }),
        5_000,
      )

      // AUD-03 (anti-enumeração): com autoSignIn=false, o better-auth
      // responde com um usuário sintético (nunca persistido) para email já
      // registrado — hasheando a senha no caminho para igualar o timing.
      // O pós-check detecta o sintético por id inexistente e devolve null;
      // o endpoint responde 201 genérico, sem expor existência de conta.
      const existing = await this.findByEmail(input.email)
      if (existing && existing.id !== createdUser.id) {
        return null
      }

      if (input.consentTermsVersion) {
        await db
          .update(user)
          .set({
            consentTermsVersion: input.consentTermsVersion,
            consentTermsAcceptedAt: new Date(),
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          })
          .where(eq(user.id, createdUser.id))
      }

      return {
        id: createdUser.id,
        email: createdUser.email,
        name: createdUser.name,
        isActive: true,
        createdAt: createdUser.createdAt,
        updatedAt: createdUser.createdAt,
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error instanceof TimeoutError) {
        return handleUpstreamTimeout()
      }
      // AUD-03: se a config futura desligar a resposta genérica do
      // better-auth (ex.: requireEmailVerification no fluxo de verificação),
      // email duplicado volta a virar 422 — devolve null, nunca 409.
      if (error?.statusCode === 422) {
        return null
      }
      if (error instanceof H3Error) {
        throw error
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Signs in with timing-equalized paths (AUD-07): deactivated accounts pay
   * the same scrypt cost before 401 `account_deactivated`. Revokes other
   * sessions first (fixation protection). 401 invalid credentials, 403
   * `email_not_verified` (correct password proven), 503 on timeout.
   * The returned `setCookie` must be forwarded or no session is established.
   */
  async signIn(input: SignInInput, headers?: Headers): Promise<UserResult> {
    try {
      const existing = await this.findByEmail(input.email)
      if (existing && !existing.isActive) {
        // AUD-07 (anti-enumeração por timing): conta desativada não passava
        // pelo better-auth — não pagava a query findUserByEmail nem o scrypt
        // (~50-150ms), sendo ~15x mais rápida que os outros caminhos. O pad
        // abaixo replica o custo do caminho de email inexistente (query +
        // verify de scrypt) com a mesma maquinaria do better-auth, antes de
        // lançar o account_deactivated de sempre. A senha-pad é impossível
        // de acertar, então a chamada nunca cria sessão; se mesmo assim
        // resolver (mudança futura de comportamento do better-auth), a
        // sessão vazada é revogada antes do throw — esta branch nunca
        // retorna sucesso.
        const authInstance = await this.resolveAuth()
        await withTimeout(
          authInstance.api.signInEmail({
            body: {
              email: input.email,
              password: TIMING_PAD_PASSWORD,
              rememberMe: false,
            },
            headers,
            returnHeaders: true,
          }),
          5_000,
        )
          .then(async (result: any) => {
            logger.warn('AUD-07: timing pad resolved unexpectedly, revoking session', {
              email: input.email,
            })
            const sessionToken = result?.response?.token
            if (sessionToken) {
              await this.terminateSession(sessionToken)
            }
          })
          .catch(() => {
            // Erro esperado (401 de credenciais inválidas) ou timeout do pad
            // (5s): ambos são engolidos — o account_deactivated abaixo é a
            // única resposta possível desta branch.
          })

        throw createError({
          status: 401,
          statusText: '401',
          message: JSON.stringify({
            error: 'account_deactivated',
            message: 'User has been deactivated',
          }),
        })
      }

      const authInstance = await this.resolveAuth()

      // Session fixation protection: revoke all OTHER sessions for this user
      // BEFORE creating the new one, so the new session becomes the only valid one.
      const existingUser = await this.findByEmail(input.email)
      if (existingUser) {
        await this.terminateUserSessions(existingUser.id)
      }

      const result = await withTimeout(
        authInstance.api.signInEmail({
          body: {
            email: input.email,
            password: input.password,
            rememberMe: input.rememberMe ?? false,
          },
          headers,
          returnHeaders: true,
        }),
        5_000,
      )

      // FR-023: session_created — fire-and-forget para não atrasar/falhar o
      // login se o registro do evento falhar (auditoria não pode ser crítica).
      // signInEmail retorna apenas o token da sessão (sem o objeto session),
      // então o sessionId é resolvido via validateSession em background.
      const sessionToken = result.response.token

      void this.validateSession(sessionToken)
        .then((validated) => {
          if (!validated) return
          return createAuthEvent({
            userId: validated.user.id,
            email: validated.user.email,
            eventType: 'session_created',
            metadata: {
              sessionId: validated.session.id,
              userId: validated.user.id,
              tenantId: (validated.session as any)?.activeCompanyId ?? null,
            },
          })
        })
        .catch((error: unknown) => {
          logger.warn('Failed to emit session_created event', {
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          })
        })

      return {
        id: result.response.user.id,
        email: result.response.user.email,
        name: result.response.user.name,
        isActive: true,
        createdAt: result.response.user.createdAt,
        updatedAt: result.response.user.updatedAt,
        setCookie: result.headers?.getSetCookie?.() ?? [],
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error instanceof TimeoutError) {
        return handleUpstreamTimeout()
      }
      if (error?.statusCode === 401) {
        throw error
      }
      // AUD-04: com requireEmailVerification, o better-auth responde 403
      // email_not_verified — DEPOIS do verify de scrypt da senha (senha
      // correta comprovada), então não vaza existência de conta. Reformatado
      // no padrão JSON do app para o handler de login mapear a razão.
      if (error?.statusCode === 403) {
        throw createError({
          status: 403,
          statusText: '403',
          message: JSON.stringify({
            error: 'email_not_verified',
            message: 'Please verify your email address before logging in.',
          }),
        })
      }
      if (error instanceof H3Error) {
        throw error
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  // AUD-04: reenvio do link de verificação. O better-auth responde
  // {status:true} para qualquer email (existente ou não) com piso de 500ms —
  // anti-enumeração embutida; o envio real só ocorre para conta existente
  // não-verificada.
  /** Resends the verification link — identical outcome for any email (anti-enumeration). */
  async sendVerificationEmail(email: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const authInstance = await this.resolveAuth()
      await withTimeout(authInstance.api.sendVerificationEmail({ body: { email } }), 5_000)
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error instanceof TimeoutError) {
        return handleUpstreamTimeout()
      }
      if (error instanceof H3Error) {
        throw error
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  // AUD-04: destino do link de verificação (GET). O token é um JWT assinado
  // com TTL de 1h (expiresIn do emailVerification); idempotente — verificar
  // email já verificado retorna sucesso.
  /** Verifies email ownership via signed JWT (1h TTL, idempotent). 400 on invalid/expired token. */
  async verifyEmail(token: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const authInstance = await this.resolveAuth()
      await withTimeout(authInstance.api.verifyEmail({ query: { token } }), 5_000)
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error instanceof TimeoutError) {
        return handleUpstreamTimeout()
      }
      // Token inválido/expirado (APIError 400/401) → resposta genérica; nada
      // a enumerar: o JWT não é forjável.
      if (error?.statusCode === 400 || error?.statusCode === 401) {
        sendValidationError('Invalid or expired verification link')
      }
      if (error instanceof H3Error) {
        throw error
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  // AUD-04: "esqueci minha senha". Resposta genérica e idêntica para email
  // existente ou não (o better-auth gera o token e simula o lookup no
  // caminho inexistente — anti-enumeração embutida). O redirectTo é a
  // origem do app: o link de reset aponta para GET /api/auth/reset-password/
  // <token>?callbackURL=<origin>, que valida e redireciona para o frontend.
  /** Starts password recovery — identical outcome for any email (anti-enumeration). */
  async requestPasswordReset(email: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const authInstance = await this.resolveAuth()
      const baseURL = process.env.BETTER_AUTH_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'
      await withTimeout(
        authInstance.api.requestPasswordReset({ body: { email, redirectTo: baseURL } }),
        5_000,
      )
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error instanceof TimeoutError) {
        return handleUpstreamTimeout()
      }
      if (error instanceof H3Error) {
        throw error
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  // AUD-04: define a nova senha com o token de reset. Uso único
  // (consumeVerificationValue do better-auth), TTL de 1h; com
  // revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset, todas as sessões do usuário são
  // revogadas. Token inválido/consumido/expirado → 400 genérico.
  /** Sets a new password via single-use reset token; revokes all sessions. 400 on invalid/consumed/expired token. */
  async resetPassword(token: string, newPassword: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const authInstance = await this.resolveAuth()
      await withTimeout(
        authInstance.api.resetPassword({ query: { token }, body: { newPassword } }),
        5_000,
      )
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error instanceof TimeoutError) {
        return handleUpstreamTimeout()
      }
      if (error?.statusCode === 400) {
        sendValidationError('Invalid or expired reset link')
      }
      if (error instanceof H3Error) {
        throw error
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  // AUD-04: valida o token de reset no clique do link (GET /api/auth/
  // reset-password/<token>). NÃO consome — o consumo de uso único acontece
  // no POST /reset-password. Acoplamento documentado: identifier no formato
  // interno do better-auth (`reset-password:${token}` na tabela verification).
  /** Checks a reset token without consuming it (click-time validation). */
  async validateResetToken(token: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const [found] = await db
        .select({ id: verification.id })
        .from(verification)
        .where(
          and(
            eq(verification.identifier, `reset-password:${token}`),
            gt(verification.expiresAt, new Date()),
          ),
        )
        .limit(1)
      return !!found
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Finds a user by email, or null. */
  async findByEmail(email: string): Promise<UserResult | null> {
    try {
      const [found] = await db.select().from(user).where(eq(user.email, email)).limit(1)

      return found || null
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Finds a user by id, or null. */
  async findById(id: string): Promise<UserResult | null> {
    try {
      const [found] = await db.select().from(user).where(eq(user.id, id)).limit(1)

      return found || null
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Persists a session row directly (used by tests/fixtures — handlers use Better Auth sign-in). */
  async createSession(
    userId: string,
    token: string,
    expiresAt: Date,
    rememberMe: boolean,
  ): Promise<SessionResult> {
    try {
      const [newSession] = await db
        .insert(session)
        .values({ userId, token, expiresAt, rememberMe })
        .returning()

      return newSession!
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Validates a session token (unexpired + active user), or null. */
  async validateSession(token: string): Promise<SessionWithUser | null> {
    try {
      const [found] = await db
        .select()
        .from(session)
        .where(and(eq(session.token, token), gt(session.expiresAt, new Date())))
        .limit(1)

      if (!found) return null

      const [userRecord] = await db.select().from(user).where(eq(user.id, found.userId)).limit(1)

      if (!userRecord || !userRecord.isActive) return null

      return {
        session: found,
        user: userRecord,
      }
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Deletes one session by token. */
  async terminateSession(token: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await db.delete(session).where(eq(session.token, token))
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Deletes all sessions of a user. */
  async terminateUserSessions(userId: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await db.delete(session).where(eq(session.userId, userId))
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Partially updates a user row (always bumps `updatedAt`). */
  async updateUser(id: string, data: Partial<UpdateUserInput>): Promise<UserResult> {
    try {
      const [updated] = await db
        .update(user)
        .set({ ...data, updatedAt: new Date() })
        .where(eq(user.id, id))
        .returning()

      return updated!
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** True when the email is already registered. */
  async isEmailTaken(email: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const [found] = await db
        .select({ id: user.id })
        .from(user)
        .where(eq(user.email, email))
        .limit(1)

      return !!found
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Withdraws LGPD consent (FR-021): stamps `consentWithdrawnAt`, deactivates
   * the account and terminates all sessions atomically. The PII
   * deletion/anonymization queue is deferred (out of scope).
   */
  async withdrawConsent(userId: string): Promise<UserResult> {
    try {
      // FR-021: retirada de consentimento desativa a conta imediatamente e
      // encerra todas as sessões em uma única transação. A fila de
      // deleção/anonymização fica fora do escopo (pendência #12 parcial).
      return await withTenant(null, userId, async (tx) => {
        await tx.delete(session).where(eq(session.userId, userId))

        const [updated] = await tx
          .update(user)
          .set({ consentWithdrawnAt: new Date(), isActive: false, updatedAt: new Date() })
          .where(eq(user.id, userId))
          .returning()

        return updated!
      })
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Deactivates a user (soft delete, FR-017) and terminates all sessions. Data is preserved. */
  async deactivateUser(userId: string): Promise<UserResult> {
    try {
      await db.delete(session).where(eq(session.userId, userId))

      const [updated] = await db
        .update(user)
        .set({ isActive: false, updatedAt: new Date() })
        .where(eq(user.id, userId))
        .returning()

      return updated!
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Lists a user's sessions (id + timestamps — no tokens, FR-020 export). */
  async getUserSessions(
    userId: string,
  ): Promise<Array<{ id: string; createdAt: Date; expiresAt: Date }>> {
    try {
      return await db
        .select({ id: session.id, createdAt: session.createdAt, expiresAt: session.expiresAt })
        .from(session)
        .where(eq(session.userId, userId))
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Lists audit events linked to a user, newest first (FR-020 LGPD export).
   * Only rows with `userId` set are returned — events recorded without a
   * user id (e.g. failed logins for unknown emails) never leak into
   * another user's export. Metadata is excluded: it can reference other
   * entities (company ids, invited emails) outside the export scope.
   */
  async listUserAuthEvents(
    userId: string,
  ): Promise<Array<{ id: string; eventType: string; ipAddress: string | null; createdAt: Date }>> {
    try {
      return await db
        .select({
          id: authEvent.id,
          eventType: authEvent.eventType,
          ipAddress: authEvent.ipAddress,
          createdAt: authEvent.createdAt,
        })
        .from(authEvent)
        .where(eq(authEvent.userId, userId))
        .orderBy(desc(authEvent.createdAt))
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }
}

export const identityRepository = new IdentityRepository()

const dbAvailable = process.env.DB_AVAILABLE === 'true'

    const inviteeEmail = `invitee-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Owner')

    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner(

    )

    const created = await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: inviteeEmail,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })
    expect(created).toMatchObject({ companyId: createdCompany.id, email: inviteeEmail })
    expect(created.token).toBeTruthy()
    // AUD-01: hash nunca sai do repositório — o que segue para a API é só o token
    expect(created).not.toHaveProperty('tokenHash')
    expect(created.expiresAt.getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now())

    const pending = await repo.findPendingInvite(createdCompany.id, inviteeEmail)
    expect(pending?.id).toBe(created.id)

    const listed = await repo.listCompanyInvites(createdCompany.id)
    expect(listed.map((i: any) => i.id)).toContain(created.id)

    const accepted = await repo.acceptInvite(created.token, inviteeEmail, invitee.id)
    expect(accepted.acceptedAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date)

    expect(await repo.findPendingInvite(createdCompany.id, inviteeEmail)).toBeNull()
    expect(await company.isCompanyMember(invitee.id, createdCompany.id)).toBe(true)
    expect(await company.getCompanyMembershipRole(invitee.id, createdCompany.id)).toBe('member')
  })

  it('rejects duplicate invites for the same company and email', async () => {
    const ownerEmail = `dupowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const inviteeEmail = `dupinvitee-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Dup Owner')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Dup Company' }, owner.id)

    await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: inviteeEmail,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })

    await expect(
      repo.createInvite({ companyId: createdCompany.id, email: inviteeEmail, invitedBy: owner.id }),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 409 })
  })

  it('returns null for expired invites', async () => {
    const ownerEmail = `expowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Exp Owner')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Exp Company' }, owner.id)

    const { withTenant } = await import('~~/server/utils/auth/tenant-context')
    const { invite } = await import('~~/server/utils/schema')
    const { eq } = await import('drizzle-orm')

    const created = await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: `expired-${Date.now()}@example.com`,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })

    await withTenant(createdCompany.id, owner.id, async (tx) => {
      await tx
        .update(invite)
        .set({ expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 60_000) })
        .where(eq(invite.id, created.id))
    })

    // AUD-01: token expirado também não aceita
    await expect(repo.acceptInvite(created.token, created.email, owner.id)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 404,
    })
  })

  it('is single-use: a consumed token cannot be accepted again', async () => {
    const ownerEmail = `oneowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const inviteeEmail = `oneinvitee-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'One Owner')
    const invitee = await registerUser(inviteeEmail, 'One Invitee')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'One Company' }, owner.id)

    const created = await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: inviteeEmail,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })

    await repo.acceptInvite(created.token, inviteeEmail, invitee.id)
    await expect(repo.acceptInvite(created.token, inviteeEmail, invitee.id)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 404,
    })
  })

  it('rejects a token presented by a different email (posse do token + email da sessão)', async () => {
    const ownerEmail = `diffowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const inviteeEmail = `diffinvitee-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const otherEmail = `other-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Diff Owner')
    const invitee = await registerUser(inviteeEmail, 'Diff Invitee')
    const other = await registerUser(otherEmail, 'Other User')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Diff Company' }, owner.id)

    const created = await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: inviteeEmail,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })

    await expect(repo.acceptInvite(created.token, otherEmail, other.id)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 404,
    })

    // o convite segue válido para o destinatário certo
    const pending = await repo.findPendingInvite(createdCompany.id, inviteeEmail)
    expect(pending?.id).toBe(created.id)
    expect(await company.isCompanyMember(other.id, createdCompany.id)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('rejects a forged token (nothing matches an unknown hash)', async () => {
    const ownerEmail = `forgedowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const inviteeEmail = `forgedinvitee-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Forged Owner')
    const invitee = await registerUser(inviteeEmail, 'Forged Invitee')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner(
      { name: 'Forged Company' },
      owner.id,
    )

    const created = await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: inviteeEmail,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })

    await expect(
      repo.acceptInvite(`${created.token}x`, inviteeEmail, invitee.id),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 404 })
  })

  it('RLS backstop: direct member self-insert without token or bootstrap flag is denied', async () => {
    // AUD-01: mesmo que o check de app fosse removido, a policy cm_insert_policy
    // nega o self-insert sem token_hash válido (não setamos o flag de bootstrap).
    const ownerEmail = `rlsowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const attackerEmail = `rlsattacker-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Rls Owner')
    const attacker = await registerUser(attackerEmail, 'Rls Attacker')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Rls Company' }, owner.id)

    const { withTenant } = await import('~~/server/utils/auth/tenant-context')
    const { companyMember } = await import('~~/server/utils/schema')

    await expect(
      withTenant(createdCompany.id, attacker.id, async (tx) => {
        await tx.insert(companyMember).values({
          companyId: createdCompany.id,
          userId: attacker.id,
          role: 'member',
        })
      }),
    ).rejects.toThrow()

    expect(await company.isCompanyMember(attacker.id, createdCompany.id)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('RLS backstop: member (non-owner) cannot UPDATE invites in the company', async () => {
    // AUD-01 residual: a policy antiga (invite_update_policy sem check de role)
    // deixava qualquer member alterar invites pendentes. Agora o UPDATE exige
    // owner OU o claim por token — member sem token é negado no banco.
    const ownerEmail = `updowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const memberEmail = `updmember-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const inviteeEmail = `updinvitee-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Upd Owner')
    const member = await registerUser(memberEmail, 'Upd Member')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Upd Company' }, owner.id)
    await company.createCompanyMember(createdCompany.id, member.id, 'member')

    const created = await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: inviteeEmail,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })

    const { withTenant } = await import('~~/server/utils/auth/tenant-context')
    const { invite } = await import('~~/server/utils/schema')
    const { eq } = await import('drizzle-orm')

    // RLS de UPDATE filtra silenciosamente (0 rows) — o member não vê erro,
    // mas a linha não muda; o invite continua intacto para o destinatário.
    const hijackedEmail = `hijack-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const rows = await withTenant(createdCompany.id, member.id, async (tx) => {
      return tx
        .update(invite)
        .set({ email: hijackedEmail })
        .where(eq(invite.id, created.id))
        .returning({ id: invite.id })
    })
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(0)

    const pending = await repo.findPendingInvite(createdCompany.id, inviteeEmail)
    expect(pending?.id).toBe(created.id)
    expect(pending?.email).not.toBe(hijackedEmail)
  })
})

## FILE: server/utils/auth/invite/repository.ts

```
import { and, eq, gt, isNull, sql } from 'drizzle-orm'
import { createHash, randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'
import { db } from '../../db'
import { companyMember, invite } from '../../schema'
import { H3Error } from 'h3'
import {
  handleDatabaseError,
  sendConflictError,
  sendNotFoundError,
  isPgConflict,
} from '../../shared/errors'
import { withTenant } from '../tenant-context'

export interface CreateInviteInput {
  companyId: string
  email: string
  invitedBy: string
}

export interface InviteResult {
  id: string
  companyId: string
  email: string
  invitedBy: string
  acceptedAt: Date | null
  expiresAt: Date
  createdAt: Date
}

export interface CreatedInviteResult extends InviteResult {
  token: string
}

const INVITE_TTL_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000

// AUD-01: token de aceite com 256 bits de entropia; no banco só o hash
// SHA-256 (dump da base não vaza tokens utilizáveis).
export function hashToken(token: string): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex')
}

function generateToken(): { token: string; tokenHash: string } {
  const token = randomBytes(32).toString('base64url')
  return { token, tokenHash: hashToken(token) }
}

// Nunca devolver tokenHash para fora do módulo — é segredo de auditoria.
type Row = typeof invite.$inferSelect
function toInviteResult(row: Row): InviteResult {
  const { tokenHash: _tokenHash, ...rest } = row
  return rest
}

/** Invite repository — tokens carry 256-bit entropy; only the SHA-256 hash is stored. */
export class InviteRepository {
  /**
   * Creates an invite (7d TTL). Returns the accept token exactly once —
   * callers must not persist or re-expose it. 409 when an invite for the
   * company already exists.
   */
  async createInvite(input: CreateInviteInput): Promise<CreatedInviteResult> {
    try {
      return await withTenant(input.companyId, input.invitedBy, async (tx) => {
        const { token, tokenHash } = generateToken()
        const [created] = await tx
          .insert(invite)
          .values({
            companyId: input.companyId,
            email: input.email,
            invitedBy: input.invitedBy,
            tokenHash,
            expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + INVITE_TTL_MS),
          })
          .returning()
        return { ...toInviteResult(created!), token }
      })
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (isPgConflict(error)) {
        sendConflictError('Invite already exists for this company')
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Finds a non-expired, unaccepted invite for (company, email), or null. */
  async findPendingInvite(companyId: string, email: string): Promise<InviteResult | null> {
    try {
      return await withTenant(companyId, null, async (tx) => {
        const [found] = await tx
          .select()
          .from(invite)
          .where(
            and(
              eq(invite.companyId, companyId),
              eq(invite.email, email),
              isNull(invite.acceptedAt),
              gt(invite.expiresAt, new Date()),
            ),
          )
          .limit(1)
        return found ? toInviteResult(found) : null
      })
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  /** Lists a company's invites as metadata (never tokens). */
  async listCompanyInvites(companyId: string): Promise<InviteResult[]> {
    try {
      return await withTenant(companyId, null, async (tx) => {
        return (await tx.select().from(invite).where(eq(invite.companyId, companyId))).map(
          toInviteResult,
        )
      })
    } catch (error) {
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }

  // AUD-01: aceite por token de uso único. O lookup e o claim rodam com o GUC
  // app.invite_token_hash setado na transação — o SELECT passa pela policy de
  // token e o INSERT de member pelo backstop cm_insert_policy (que valida o
  // hash + email da sessão no banco). Token reutilizado ou expirado → 404
  // genérico; membro já existente → 409 (rollback, token não é consumido).
  /**
   * Claims an invite by secret token and creates the membership as `member`.
   * Single-use and race-safe (conditional claim UPDATE). 404 for
   * invalid/expired/consumed tokens or email mismatch; 409 when the user is
   * already a member (token is NOT consumed on 409).
   */
  async acceptInvite(token: string, email: string, userId: string): Promise<InviteResult> {
    try {
      const tokenHash = hashToken(token)

      return await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        const pending = await withTenant(
          null,
          userId,
          async (t) => {
            await t.execute(sql`SELECT set_config('app.invite_token_hash', ${tokenHash}, true)`)
            const [found] = await t
              .select()
              .from(invite)
              .where(
                and(
                  eq(invite.tokenHash, tokenHash),
                  eq(invite.email, email),
                  isNull(invite.acceptedAt),
                  gt(invite.expiresAt, new Date()),
                ),
              )
              .limit(1)
            return found || null
          },
          tx,
        )

        if (!pending) {
          sendNotFoundError('Invite not found or expired')
        }

        return withTenant(
          pending!.companyId,
          userId,
          async (t) => {
            await t.execute(sql`SELECT set_config('app.invite_token_hash', ${tokenHash}, true)`)

            const [claimed] = await t
              .update(invite)
              .set({ acceptedAt: new Date() })
              .where(
                and(
                  eq(invite.id, pending!.id),
                  isNull(invite.acceptedAt),
                  gt(invite.expiresAt, new Date()),
                ),
              )
              .returning()

            if (!claimed) {
              // claim perdido (uso concorrente) ou expirado entre o SELECT e o UPDATE
              sendNotFoundError('Invite not found or expired')
            }

            await t
              .insert(companyMember)
              .values({ companyId: pending!.companyId, userId, role: 'member' })

            return toInviteResult(claimed!)
          },
          tx,
        )
      })
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (isPgConflict(error)) {
        sendConflictError('User is already a member of this company')
      }
      if (error instanceof H3Error) {
        throw error
      }
      return handleDatabaseError(error)
    }
  }
}

export const inviteRepository = new InviteRepository()

```

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { db } from '../db'
import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm'

const dbAvailable = process.env.DB_AVAILABLE === 'true'

describe.skipIf(!dbAvailable)('withTenant (integration)', () => {
  it('sets app.tenant_id within transaction', async () => {
    const { withTenant } = await import('./tenant-context')

    const result = await withTenant('test-tenant-id', 'test-user-id', async (tx) => {
      const [row] = await tx.execute(sql`
        SELECT current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) AS tenant_id,
               current_setting('app.user_id', true) AS user_id
      `)
      return row as { tenant_id: string; user_id: string }
    })

    expect(result.tenant_id).toBe('test-tenant-id')
    expect(result.user_id).toBe('test-user-id')
  })

  it('clears context after transaction ends', async () => {
    const { withTenant } = await import('./tenant-context')

    await withTenant('temp-tenant', 'temp-user', async (_tx) => {
      // context is set inside
    })

    const [row] = await db.execute(sql`
      SELECT current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) AS tenant_id
    `)
    // Fail-closed: fora da transação o GUC volta a ausente (NULL) ou vazio
    // ('') — ambos mapeiam para NULL via NULLIF no get_tenant_id() → RLS nega.
    expect([null, '']).toContain((row as any).tenant_id)
  })

  it('reuses an existing transaction when existingTx is passed', async () => {
    const { withTenant } = await import('./tenant-context')

    const result = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      return await withTenant(
        'outer-tenant',
        'outer-user',
        async (ctxTx) => {
          const [row] = await ctxTx.execute(sql`
            SELECT current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) AS tenant_id,
                   current_setting('app.user_id', true) AS user_id
          `)
          return row as { tenant_id: string; user_id: string }
        },
        tx,
      )
    })

    expect(result.tenant_id).toBe('outer-tenant')
    expect(result.user_id).toBe('outer-user')
  })

  it('context set via existingTx persists until the outer transaction commits', async () => {
    const { withTenant } = await import('./tenant-context')

    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await withTenant(
        'persist-tenant',
        null,
        async (ctxTx) => {
          await ctxTx.execute(sql`SELECT 1`)
        },
        tx,
      )

      const [row] = await tx.execute(sql`
        SELECT current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) AS tenant_id
      `)
      expect((row as { tenant_id: string }).tenant_id).toBe('persist-tenant')
    })

    const [row] = await db.execute(sql`
      SELECT current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) AS tenant_id
    `)
    expect([null, '']).toContain((row as any).tenant_id)
  })

  it('clears outer tenant when nested withTenant(null) reuses the transaction', async () => {
    const { withTenant } = await import('./tenant-context')

    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await withTenant('outer-tenant', 'outer-user', async () => {}, tx)

      await withTenant(
        null,
        'other-user',
        async (ctxTx) => {
          const [row] = await ctxTx.execute(sql`
            SELECT current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) AS tenant_id,
                   current_setting('app.user_id', true) AS user_id
          `)
          const r = row as { tenant_id: string | null; user_id: string | null }
          expect([null, '']).toContain(r.tenant_id)
          expect(r.user_id).toBe('other-user')
        },
        tx,
      )
    })
  })
})

import { pgTable, text, timestamp, integer, index, jsonb } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core'

export const authSecurityState = pgTable(
  'auth_security_state',
  {
    key: text('key').primaryKey(),
    count: integer('count').notNull().default(0),
    lockedUntil: timestamp('locked_until', { withTimezone: true }),
    resetAt: timestamp('reset_at', { withTimezone: true }),
    // FR-010: janela deslizante — timestamps ISO de cada request no window.
    // Rows de lockout não usam esta coluna (apenas count/lockedUntil).
    window: jsonb('window').$type<string[]>().notNull().default([]),
    updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (table) => [index('auth_security_state_reset_at_idx').on(table.resetAt)],
)

/**
 * Shared shapes for `event.context` set by `server/middleware/auth.ts`.
 * Import the interfaces in handlers instead of re-declaring inline casts —
 * the `h3` module augmentation below types `event.context` globally, so new
 * code gets autocomplete and drift between handlers becomes a type error.
 */
export interface AuthContextUser {
  id: string
  email: string
  name: string | null
}

export interface AuthContextSession {
  id: string
  activeCompanyId?: string | null
}

declare module 'h3' {
  interface H3EventContext {
    user?: AuthContextUser
    session?: AuthContextSession
    tenantId?: string | null
    userId?: string
    activeCompanyId?: string | null
  }
}

```
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import {
  MAX_REQUESTS_PER_USER,
  evaluateLockout,
  evaluateRateLimit,
  isValidCnpj,
  isWeakPassword,
  normalizeEmail,
} from './security'

describe('normalizeEmail', () => {
  it('trims whitespace and lowercases', () => {
    expect(normalizeEmail('  Foo@Bar.com  ')).toBe('foo@bar.com')
  })

  it('keeps already normalized emails unchanged', () => {
    expect(normalizeEmail('foo@bar.com')).toBe('foo@bar.com')
  })
})

describe('isWeakPassword', () => {
  it('flags common passwords case-insensitively', () => {
    expect(isWeakPassword('Password123')).toBe(true)
    expect(isWeakPassword('qwerty')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('accepts non-common passwords', () => {
    expect(isWeakPassword('Str0ngP@ssw0rd!2026')).toBe(false)
  })
})

describe('isValidCnpj', () => {
  it('accepts a valid CNPJ with and without mask', () => {
    expect(isValidCnpj('11222333000181')).toBe(true)
    expect(isValidCnpj('11.222.333/0001-81')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('rejects wrong check digits', () => {
    expect(isValidCnpj('12345678000190')).toBe(false)
    expect(isValidCnpj('12345678901234')).toBe(false)
  })

  it('rejects wrong length and repeated digits', () => {
    expect(isValidCnpj('123')).toBe(false)
    expect(isValidCnpj('')).toBe(false)
    expect(isValidCnpj('00000000000000')).toBe(false)
    expect(isValidCnpj('11.222.333/0001-8')).toBe(false)
  })
})

describe('evaluateRateLimit', () => {
  const now = new Date('2026-08-02T12:00:00.000Z')
  const t = (sec: number) => new Date(now.getTime() + sec * 1000).toISOString()

  it('allows the first request and opens the window', () => {
    const result = evaluateRateLimit(null, now)

    expect(result).toEqual({
      allowed: true,
      nextWindow: [now.toISOString()],
    })
  })

  it('allows requests while fewer than 5 hits in the last 60s', () => {
    const entry = { window: [t(-30), t(-20), t(-10), t(-5)] }

    const result = evaluateRateLimit(entry, now)

    expect(result.allowed).toBe(true)
    expect(result.nextWindow).toEqual([...entry.window, now.toISOString()])
  })

  it('blocks the 6th request within 60s with retryAfter (FR-010)', () => {
    const entry = { window: [t(-50), t(-40), t(-30), t(-20), t(-10)] }

    const result = evaluateRateLimit(entry, now)

    expect(result.allowed).toBe(false)
    // o hit mais antigo sai da janela em 10s
    expect(result.retryAfter).toBe(10)
  })

  it('sliding window: drops hits older than 60s before counting', () => {
    // 5 hits, mas o mais antigo já saiu da janela de 60s
    const entry = { window: [t(-61), t(-40), t(-30), t(-20), t(-10)] }

    const result = evaluateRateLimit(entry, now)

    expect(result.allowed).toBe(true)
    expect(result.nextWindow).toEqual([t(-40), t(-30), t(-20), t(-10), now.toISOString()])
  })

  it('no burst across adjacent fixed windows: 5 hits at 59s ago still block', () => {
    const entry = { window: [t(-59), t(-40), t(-30), t(-20), t(-10)] }

    const result = evaluateRateLimit(entry, now)

    expect(result.allowed).toBe(false)
    expect(result.retryAfter).toBe(1)
  })

  it('applies a different cap when maxRequests is provided (per-IP)', () => {
    const allowed = evaluateRateLimit({ window: [t(-5), t(-4)] }, now, 20)
    expect(allowed.allowed).toBe(true)

    const blocked = evaluateRateLimit(
      { window: [t(-59), t(-50), t(-40), t(-30), t(-20), t(-10)] },
      now,
      5,
    )
    expect(blocked.allowed).toBe(false)
  })

  it('AUD-16: applies the per-user cap (MAX_REQUESTS_PER_USER = 60)', () => {
    // 59 hits na janela: abaixo do teto de 60.
    const hits = Array.from({ length: 59 }, (_, i) => t(-59 + i))

    const allowed = evaluateRateLimit({ window: hits }, now, MAX_REQUESTS_PER_USER)
    expect(allowed.allowed).toBe(true)
    expect(allowed.nextWindow.length).toBe(60)

    const blocked = evaluateRateLimit({ window: [...hits, t(-1)] }, now, MAX_REQUESTS_PER_USER)
    expect(blocked.allowed).toBe(false)
    expect(blocked.retryAfter).toBe(1)
  })

  it('AUD-16: drops hits older than 60s before counting the per-user window', () => {
    // 60 hits, mas o mais antigo (-61s) já saiu da janela — só 59 contam.
    const hits = [t(-61), ...Array.from({ length: 59 }, (_, i) => t(-59 + i))]

    const result = evaluateRateLimit({ window: hits }, now, MAX_REQUESTS_PER_USER)
    expect(result.allowed).toBe(true)
    expect(result.nextWindow.length).toBe(60)
  })
})

describe('evaluateLockout', () => {
  const now = new Date('2026-08-02T12:00:00.000Z')

  it('does not lock before 10 failures', () => {
    const result = evaluateLockout(3, null, now)

    expect(result.locked).toBe(false)
    expect(result.nextAttempts).toBe(4)
    expect(result.nextLockedUntil).toBeNull()
  })

  it('locks for 30 minutes at the 10th failure', () => {
    const result = evaluateLockout(9, null, now)

    expect(result.locked).toBe(false)
    expect(result.nextAttempts).toBe(10)
    expect(result.nextLockedUntil).toEqual(new Date('2026-08-02T12:30:00.000Z'))
  })

  it('reports locked while lockedUntil is in the future', () => {
    const result = evaluateLockout(10, new Date('2026-08-02T12:30:00.000Z'), now)

    expect(result.locked).toBe(true)
    expect(result.nextAttempts).toBe(10)
    expect(result.nextLockedUntil).toEqual(new Date('2026-08-02T12:30:00.000Z'))
  })

  it('resets the counter once the lockout expires', () => {
    const result = evaluateLockout(10, new Date('2026-08-02T11:00:00.000Z'), now)

    expect(result.locked).toBe(false)
    expect(result.nextAttempts).toBe(1)
    expect(result.nextLockedUntil).toBeNull()
  })

  it('locks at the 50th failure when maxAttempts is raised (global tier, AUD-02)', () => {
    const result = evaluateLockout(49, null, now, 50)

    expect(result.locked).toBe(false)
    expect(result.nextAttempts).toBe(50)
    expect(result.nextLockedUntil).toEqual(new Date('2026-08-02T12:30:00.000Z'))
  })
})
