```
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import {
  MAX_REQUESTS_PER_USER,
  evaluateLockout,
  evaluateRateLimit,
  isValidCnpj,
  isWeakPassword,
  normalizeEmail,
} from './security'

describe('normalizeEmail', () => {
  it('trims whitespace and lowercases', () => {
    expect(normalizeEmail('  Foo@Bar.com  ')).toBe('foo@bar.com')
  })

  it('keeps already normalized emails unchanged', () => {
    expect(normalizeEmail('foo@bar.com')).toBe('foo@bar.com')
  })
})

describe('isWeakPassword', () => {
  it('flags common passwords case-insensitively', () => {
    expect(isWeakPassword('Password123')).toBe(true)
    expect(isWeakPassword('qwerty')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('accepts non-common passwords', () => {
    expect(isWeakPassword('Str0ngP@ssw0rd!2026')).toBe(false)
  })
})

describe('isValidCnpj', () => {
  it('accepts a valid CNPJ with and without mask', () => {
    expect(isValidCnpj('11222333000181')).toBe(true)
    expect(isValidCnpj('11.222.333/0001-81')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('rejects wrong check digits', () => {
    expect(isValidCnpj('12345678000190')).toBe(false)
    expect(isValidCnpj('12345678901234')).toBe(false)
  })

  it('rejects wrong length and repeated digits', () => {
    expect(isValidCnpj('123')).toBe(false)
    expect(isValidCnpj('')).toBe(false)
    expect(isValidCnpj('00000000000000')).toBe(false)
    expect(isValidCnpj('11.222.333/0001-8')).toBe(false)
  })
})

describe('evaluateRateLimit', () => {
  const now = new Date('2026-08-02T12:00:00.000Z')
  const t = (sec: number) => new Date(now.getTime() + sec * 1000).toISOString()

  it('allows the first request and opens the window', () => {
    const result = evaluateRateLimit(null, now)

    expect(result).toEqual({
      allowed: true,
      nextWindow: [now.toISOString()],
    })
  })

  it('allows requests while fewer than 5 hits in the last 60s', () => {
    const entry = { window: [t(-30), t(-20), t(-10), t(-5)] }

    const result = evaluateRateLimit(entry, now)

    expect(result.allowed).toBe(true)
    expect(result.nextWindow).toEqual([...entry.window, now.toISOString()])
  })

  it('blocks the 6th request within 60s with retryAfter (FR-010)', () => {
    const entry = { window: [t(-50), t(-40), t(-30), t(-20), t(-10)] }

    const result = evaluateRateLimit(entry, now)

    expect(result.allowed).toBe(false)
    // o hit mais antigo sai da janela em 10s
    expect(result.retryAfter).toBe(10)
  })

  it('sliding window: drops hits older than 60s before counting', () => {
    // 5 hits, mas o mais antigo já saiu da janela de 60s
    const entry = { window: [t(-61), t(-40), t(-30), t(-20), t(-10)] }

    const result = evaluateRateLimit(entry, now)

    expect(result.allowed).toBe(true)
    expect(result.nextWindow).toEqual([t(-40), t(-30), t(-20), t(-10), now.toISOString()])
  })

  it('no burst across adjacent fixed windows: 5 hits at 59s ago still block', () => {
    const entry = { window: [t(-59), t(-40), t(-30), t(-20), t(-10)] }

    const result = evaluateRateLimit(entry, now)

    expect(result.allowed).toBe(false)
    expect(result.retryAfter).toBe(1)
  })

  it('applies a different cap when maxRequests is provided (per-IP)', () => {
    const allowed = evaluateRateLimit({ window: [t(-5), t(-4)] }, now, 20)
    expect(allowed.allowed).toBe(true)

    const blocked = evaluateRateLimit(
      { window: [t(-59), t(-50), t(-40), t(-30), t(-20), t(-10)] },
      now,
      5,
    )
    expect(blocked.allowed).toBe(false)
  })

  it('AUD-16: applies the per-user cap (MAX_REQUESTS_PER_USER = 60)', () => {
    // 59 hits na janela: abaixo do teto de 60.
    const hits = Array.from({ length: 59 }, (_, i) => t(-59 + i))

    const allowed = evaluateRateLimit({ window: hits }, now, MAX_REQUESTS_PER_USER)
    expect(allowed.allowed).toBe(true)
    expect(allowed.nextWindow.length).toBe(60)

    const blocked = evaluateRateLimit({ window: [...hits, t(-1)] }, now, MAX_REQUESTS_PER_USER)
    expect(blocked.allowed).toBe(false)
    expect(blocked.retryAfter).toBe(1)
  })

  it('AUD-16: drops hits older than 60s before counting the per-user window', () => {
    // 60 hits, mas o mais antigo (-61s) já saiu da janela — só 59 contam.
    const hits = [t(-61), ...Array.from({ length: 59 }, (_, i) => t(-59 + i))]

    const result = evaluateRateLimit({ window: hits }, now, MAX_REQUESTS_PER_USER)
    expect(result.allowed).toBe(true)
    expect(result.nextWindow.length).toBe(60)
  })
})

describe('evaluateLockout', () => {
  const now = new Date('2026-08-02T12:00:00.000Z')

  it('does not lock before 10 failures', () => {
    const result = evaluateLockout(3, null, now)

    expect(result.locked).toBe(false)
    expect(result.nextAttempts).toBe(4)
    expect(result.nextLockedUntil).toBeNull()
  })

  it('locks for 30 minutes at the 10th failure', () => {
    const result = evaluateLockout(9, null, now)

    expect(result.locked).toBe(false)
    expect(result.nextAttempts).toBe(10)
    expect(result.nextLockedUntil).toEqual(new Date('2026-08-02T12:30:00.000Z'))
  })

  it('reports locked while lockedUntil is in the future', () => {
    const result = evaluateLockout(10, new Date('2026-08-02T12:30:00.000Z'), now)

    expect(result.locked).toBe(true)
    expect(result.nextAttempts).toBe(10)
    expect(result.nextLockedUntil).toEqual(new Date('2026-08-02T12:30:00.000Z'))
  })

  it('resets the counter once the lockout expires', () => {
    const result = evaluateLockout(10, new Date('2026-08-02T11:00:00.000Z'), now)

    expect(result.locked).toBe(false)
    expect(result.nextAttempts).toBe(1)
    expect(result.nextLockedUntil).toBeNull()
  })

  it('locks at the 50th failure when maxAttempts is raised (global tier, AUD-02)', () => {
    const result = evaluateLockout(49, null, now, 50)

    expect(result.locked).toBe(false)
    expect(result.nextAttempts).toBe(50)
    expect(result.nextLockedUntil).toEqual(new Date('2026-08-02T12:30:00.000Z'))
  })
})
```

```
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll } from 'vitest'

const INTEGRATION_DB_URL = 'postgres://merp_app:merp_app@localhost:5432/merp_test'

const dbAvailable = process.env.DB_AVAILABLE === 'true'

describe.skipIf(!dbAvailable)('auth security state (integration)', () => {
  let helpers: {
    checkIpRateLimit: (event: unknown) => Promise<void>
    checkEmailRateLimit: (event: unknown, email: string) => Promise<void>
    checkUserRateLimit: (event: unknown, userId: string) => Promise<void>
    checkAccountLockout: (email: string, ip?: string | null) => Promise<void>
    recordFailedAttempt: (email: string, ip?: string | null) => Promise<void>
    resetFailedAttempts: (email: string, ip?: string | null) => Promise<void>
  }
  let db: any
  let authSecurityState: any
  let eq: any

  beforeAll(async () => {
    process.env.APP_DATABASE_URL = INTEGRATION_DB_URL
    helpers = await import('~~/server/utils/shared/security')
    db = (await import('~~/server/utils/db')).db
    authSecurityState = (await import('~~/server/utils/schema')).authSecurityState
    eq = (await import('drizzle-orm')).eq
  })

  const mockEvent = (ip?: string) => ({
    context: {},
    node: {
      req: { socket: { remoteAddress: ip ?? undefined } },
      res: { setHeader: () => {} },
    },
  })

  it('allows 5 requests per email, then blocks the 6th with 429 (FR-010)', async () => {
    const email = `rate-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const event = mockEvent()

    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      await helpers.checkEmailRateLimit(event, email)
    }

    const err = await helpers.checkEmailRateLimit(event, email).catch((e: unknown) => e)
    expect(err).toMatchObject({ statusCode: 429 })
    const body = JSON.parse((err as { message: string }).message)
    expect(body).toMatchObject({
      error: 'rate_limit_exceeded',
      message: 'Too many requests. Try again later.',
    })
    expect(body.retryAfter).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  })

  it('reopens the rate limit window once 60s elapse (sliding window)', async () => {
    const email = `rate-reset-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const event = mockEvent()

    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      await helpers.checkEmailRateLimit(event, email)
    }
    await expect(helpers.checkEmailRateLimit(event, email)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 429,
    })

    // Simula 60s decorridos: os hits saem da janela de 60s.
    const [row] = await db
      .select({ window: authSecurityState.window })
      .from(authSecurityState)
      .where(eq(authSecurityState.key, `rate:${email}`))
    const shifted = (row.window as string[]).map((hit) =>
      new Date(Date.parse(hit) - 60_000).toISOString(),
    )
    await db
      .update(authSecurityState)
      .set({ window: shifted })
      .where(eq(authSecurityState.key, `rate:${email}`))

    await expect(helpers.checkEmailRateLimit(event, email)).resolves.toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('blocks the 21st request from the same IP', async () => {
    const ip = `203.0.113.${(Date.now() % 250) + 1}`
    const event = mockEvent(ip)

    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
      await helpers.checkIpRateLimit(event)
    }

    const err = await helpers.checkIpRateLimit(event).catch((e: unknown) => e)
    expect(err).toMatchObject({ statusCode: 429 })
    const body = JSON.parse((err as { message: string }).message)
    expect(body).toMatchObject({ error: 'rate_limit_exceeded' })
  })

  it('does not rate limit by IP when the request has no socket address', async () => {
    const event = mockEvent()

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      await expect(helpers.checkIpRateLimit(event)).resolves.toBeUndefined()
    }
  })

  it('AUD-16: blocks the 61st request from the same user with key rate:user:<id>', async () => {
    const userId = `user-${Date.now()}`
    const event = mockEvent()

    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      await helpers.checkUserRateLimit(event, userId)
    }

    const err = await helpers.checkUserRateLimit(event, userId).catch((e: unknown) => e)
    expect(err).toMatchObject({ statusCode: 429 })
    const body = JSON.parse((err as { message: string }).message)
    expect(body).toMatchObject({ error: 'rate_limit_exceeded' })
    expect(body.retryAfter).toBeGreaterThan(0)

    const [row] = await db
      .select({ window: authSecurityState.window })
      .from(authSecurityState)
      .where(eq(authSecurityState.key, `rate:user:${userId}`))
    expect(row.window.length).toBe(60)
  })

  it('AUD-16: reopens the per-user window once 60s elapse (sliding window)', async () => {
    const userId = `user-reset-${Date.now()}`
    const event = mockEvent()

    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      await helpers.checkUserRateLimit(event, userId)
    }
    await expect(helpers.checkUserRateLimit(event, userId)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 429,
    })

    const [row] = await db
      .select({ window: authSecurityState.window })
      .from(authSecurityState)
      .where(eq(authSecurityState.key, `rate:user:${userId}`))
    const shifted = (row.window as string[]).map((hit) =>
      new Date(Date.parse(hit) - 60_000).toISOString(),
    )
    await db
      .update(authSecurityState)
      .set({ window: shifted })
      .where(eq(authSecurityState.key, `rate:user:${userId}`))

    await expect(helpers.checkUserRateLimit(event, userId)).resolves.toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('locks the (email, IP) pair after 10 failures from the same IP', async () => {
    const email = `lock-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const attackerIp = `203.0.113.${(Date.now() % 250) + 1}`
    const victimIp = `198.51.100.${(Date.now() % 250) + 1}`

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      await helpers.recordFailedAttempt(email, attackerIp)
    }

    await expect(helpers.checkAccountLockout(email, attackerIp)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 401,
      message: expect.stringContaining('account_locked'),
    })

    // AUD-02: o lockout por (email+IP) não bloqueia a vítima em outro IP.
    await expect(helpers.checkAccountLockout(email, victimIp)).resolves.toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('locks the account for all IPs after 50 failures from rotating IPs (global tier, AUD-02)', async () => {
    const email = `lock-global-${Date.now()}@example.com`

    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
      await helpers.recordFailedAttempt(email, `203.0.113.${(i % 250) + 1}`)
    }

    await expect(
      helpers.checkAccountLockout(email, `198.51.100.${(Date.now() % 250) + 1}`),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 401 })
  })

  it('unlocks after the lockout window elapses and resets the counter', async () => {
    const email = `lock-reset-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const ip = `203.0.113.${(Date.now() % 250) + 1}`

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      await helpers.recordFailedAttempt(email, ip)
    }
    await expect(helpers.checkAccountLockout(email, ip)).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 401 })

    await db
      .update(authSecurityState)
      .set({ lockedUntil: new Date(Date.now() - 1_000) })
      .where(eq(authSecurityState.key, `lockout:${email}:${ip}`))

    await expect(helpers.checkAccountLockout(email, ip)).resolves.toBeUndefined()

    await helpers.recordFailedAttempt(email, ip)
    await expect(helpers.checkAccountLockout(email, ip)).resolves.toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('resetFailedAttempts clears both lockout tiers', async () => {
    const email = `lock-clear-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const ip = `203.0.113.${(Date.now() % 250) + 1}`

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      await helpers.recordFailedAttempt(email, ip)
    }
    await expect(helpers.checkAccountLockout(email, ip)).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 401 })

    await helpers.resetFailedAttempts(email, ip)

    await expect(helpers.checkAccountLockout(email, ip)).resolves.toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('with no IP, failures count only toward the global tier', async () => {
    const email = `lock-noip-${Date.now()}@example.com`

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      await helpers.recordFailedAttempt(email)
    }

    // Sem IP não há camada por-par: 10 falhas (abaixo do limiar global de 50)
    // não travam nada.
    await expect(helpers.checkAccountLockout(email)).resolves.toBeUndefined()
    await expect(
      helpers.checkAccountLockout(email, `198.51.100.${(Date.now() % 250) + 1}`),
    ).resolves.toBeUndefined()
  })
})
```

## FILE: server/utils/tenant-isolation-concurrent.test.ts

```
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { db, createOwnerDbForSetupOnly } from './db'
import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm'

const dbAvailable = process.env.DB_AVAILABLE === 'true'

describe.skipIf(!dbAvailable)('Tenant isolation under concurrent load', () => {
  const ownerDb = createOwnerDbForSetupOnly()
  const TENANT_A = '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'
  const TENANT_B = '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222'
  const USER_A = '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333'
  const USER_B = '44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444444'

  beforeAll(async () => {
    await ownerDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(
        sql`INSERT INTO company (id, name) VALUES (${TENANT_A}, 'Tenant A') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
      )
      await tx.execute(
        sql`INSERT INTO company (id, name) VALUES (${TENANT_B}, 'Tenant B') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
      )
      await tx.execute(
        sql`INSERT INTO "user" (id, email, name) VALUES (${USER_A}, 'usera@test.com', 'User A') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
      )
      await tx.execute(
        sql`INSERT INTO "user" (id, email, name) VALUES (${USER_B}, 'userb@test.com', 'User B') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
      )
      await tx.execute(sql`
        INSERT INTO company_member (company_id, user_id, role)
        VALUES (${TENANT_A}, ${USER_A}, 'member')
        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
      `)
      await tx.execute(sql`
        INSERT INTO company_member (company_id, user_id, role)
        VALUES (${TENANT_B}, ${USER_B}, 'member')
        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
      `)
    })
  })

  it('20 concurrent operations: 10 per tenant, zero cross-tenant leakage', async () => {
    const iterations = 100
    const concurrency = 20

    for (let iter = 0; iter < iterations; iter++) {
      const promises: Promise<void>[] = []

      for (let i = 0; i < concurrency; i++) {
        const isTenantA = i < 10
        const tenantId = isTenantA ? TENANT_A : TENANT_B
        const userId = isTenantA ? USER_A : USER_B

        promises.push(
          db.transaction(async (tx) => {
            await tx.execute(sql`SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', ${tenantId}, true)`)
            await tx.execute(sql`SELECT set_config('app.user_id', ${userId}, true)`)

            // Insert a row for this tenant
            const id = `${tenantId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8)}${iter.toString().padStart(4, '0')}${i.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`
            await tx.execute(sql`
              INSERT INTO company (id, name) VALUES (${id}, ${`Test ${tenantId} ${iter}-${i}`})
              ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
            `)

            // Verify only this tenant's rows are visible
            const [countRow] = await tx.execute(
              sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company WHERE id LIKE ${`${tenantId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8)}%`}`,
            )
            const ownCount = Number((countRow as any).count)

            const [otherCountRow] = await tx.execute(
              sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company WHERE id LIKE ${`${(isTenantA ? TENANT_B : TENANT_A).replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8)}%`}`,
            )
            const otherCount = Number((otherCountRow as any).count)

            if (otherCount > 0) {
              throw new Error(
                `CROSS-TENANT LEAK: tenant ${tenantId} sees ${otherCount} rows from other tenant`,
              )
            }
          }),
        )
      }

      await Promise.all(promises)
    }
  })

  it('100 iterations: rapid tenant switching in same connection pool', async () => {
    const iterations = 100
    const seenOtherTenant: string[] = []

    for (let i = 0; i < iterations; i++) {
      // Alternate between tenants rapidly
      const tenantId = i % 2 === 0 ? TENANT_A : TENANT_B
      const userId = i % 2 === 0 ? USER_A : USER_B
      const otherTenantId = i % 2 === 0 ? TENANT_B : TENANT_A

      await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', ${tenantId}, true)`)
        await tx.execute(sql`SELECT set_config('app.user_id', ${userId}, true)`)

        const [row] = await tx.execute(
          sql`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company WHERE id LIKE ${`${otherTenantId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8)}%`}`,
        )
        const count = Number((row as any).count)

        if (count > 0) {
          seenOtherTenant.push(
            `iteration ${i}: tenant ${tenantId} saw ${count} rows from ${otherTenantId}`,
          )
        }
      })
    }

    expect(seenOtherTenant).toHaveLength(0)
```
```
  })
})
```

```
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

const mockCreateCompanyWithOwner = vi.fn()
const mockReadBody = vi.fn()
const mockCheckIpRateLimit = vi.fn()
const mockSetResponseStatus = vi.fn()

vi.mock('h3', () => ({
  defineEventHandler: (fn: any) => fn,
  readBody: mockReadBody,
  setResponseStatus: mockSetResponseStatus,
  createError: (opts: any) => {
    const err = new Error(opts.message)
    ;(err as any).status = opts.status
    ;(err as any).statusCode = opts.status
    throw err
  },
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/security', async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal()),
  checkIpRateLimit: mockCheckIpRateLimit,
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository', () => ({
  companyRepository: {
    createCompanyWithOwner: mockCreateCompanyWithOwner,
  },
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/errors', () => ({
  sendValidationError: (msg: string) => {
    throw new Error(msg)
  },
}))

describe('POST /api/auth/companies', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    mockCheckIpRateLimit.mockResolvedValue(undefined)
  })

  it('requires authentication', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: {} } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('Authentication required.')
  })

  it('AUD-14: checks IP rate limit before reading the body', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ name: 'Test Company' })
    mockCreateCompanyWithOwner.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'company-1', name: 'Test Company' })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' } } } as any

    await handler(event)

    expect(mockCheckIpRateLimit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(event)
  })

  it('returns 429 from IP rate limit without reading the body', async () => {
    const ipError: any = new Error('rate limited')
    ipError.status = 429
    ipError.statusCode = 429
    mockCheckIpRateLimit.mockRejectedValue(ipError)

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' } } } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 429 })
    expect(mockReadBody).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mockCreateCompanyWithOwner).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('validates company name is required', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({})

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' } } } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('Company name is required')
    expect(mockCreateCompanyWithOwner).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('AUD-21: rejects company name over 200 chars', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ name: 'x'.repeat(201) })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' } } } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('Company name must be at most 200 characters')
    expect(mockCreateCompanyWithOwner).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('AUD-21/23: rejects non-string cnpj instead of throwing TypeError', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ name: 'Test Company', cnpj: 12345678901234 })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' } } } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('cnpj must be a string')
    expect(mockCreateCompanyWithOwner).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('AUD-21: rejects cnpj over 30 chars', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ name: 'Test Company', cnpj: '1'.repeat(31) })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' } } } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('cnpj must be at most 30 characters')
    expect(mockCreateCompanyWithOwner).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('rejects cnpj with invalid check digits', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ name: 'Test Company', cnpj: '12345678000190' })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' } } } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('cnpj is invalid')
    expect(mockCreateCompanyWithOwner).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('creates company and makes user first member as owner', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ name: 'Test Company', cnpj: '11222333000181' })
    mockCreateCompanyWithOwner.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'company-1', name: 'Test Company' })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' } } } as any

    const result = await handler(event)

    expect(mockCreateCompanyWithOwner).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      {
        name: 'Test Company',
        cnpj: '11222333000181',
        razaoSocial: undefined,
      },
      'user-1',
    )
    expect(result).toEqual({ id: 'company-1', name: 'Test Company' })
    expect(mockSetResponseStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith(event, 201)
  })

  it('trims company name', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ name: '  My Company  ' })
    mockCreateCompanyWithOwner.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'company-1', name: 'My Company' })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' } } } as any

    await handler(event)

    expect(mockCreateCompanyWithOwner).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      {
        name: 'My Company',
        cnpj: undefined,
        razaoSocial: undefined,
      },
      'user-1',
    )
  })
})
```

```
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

const mockFindCompanyById = vi.fn()
const mockIsCompanyMember = vi.fn()

    ;(err as any).status = opts.status
    ;(err as any).statusCode = opts.status
    throw err
  },
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository', () => ({

  },
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/errors', () => ({
  sendValidationError: (msg: string) => {
    throw new Error(msg)
  },
  sendNotFoundError: (msg: string) => {

    ;(err as any).status = 404
    throw err
  },

    const err = new Error(msg)
    ;(err as any).status = 403
    throw err
  },
}))

describe('POST /api/auth/companies/switch', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
  })

  it('requires authentication', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.switch.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: {} } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('Authentication required.')
  })

  it('validates companyId is required', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({})

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.switch.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' }, session: { id: 'session-1' } } } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('Company ID is required')
    expect(mockSetActiveCompany).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('returns 404 when company not found', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ companyId: 'nonexistent' })
    mockFindCompanyById.mockResolvedValue(null)

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.switch.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' }, session: { id: 'session-1' } } } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('Company not found or deleted')
  })

  it('returns 403 when user is not a member', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ companyId: 'company-1' })
    mockFindCompanyById.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'company-1', name: 'Test Company' })
    mockIsCompanyMember.mockResolvedValue(false)

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.switch.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' }, session: { id: 'session-1' } } } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('User is not a member of the specified company')
  })

  it('switches active company successfully', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ companyId: 'company-1' })
    mockFindCompanyById.mockResolvedValue({ id: 'company-1', name: 'Test Company' })
    mockIsCompanyMember.mockResolvedValue(true)
    mockSetActiveCompany.mockResolvedValue(undefined)

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/companies.switch.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { context: { user: { id: 'user-1' }, session: { id: 'session-1' } } } as any

    const result = await handler(event)

    expect(mockSetActiveCompany).toHaveBeenCalledWith('session-1', 'company-1', 'user-1')
    expect(result).toEqual({ message: 'Active company switched' })
    expect(event.context.activeCompanyId).toBe('company-1')
```
```
  })
})
```

```
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

const mockRequestPasswordReset = vi.fn()
const mockCheckIpRateLimit = vi.fn()
const mockCheckEmailRateLimit = vi.fn()
const mockSendValidationError = vi.fn()
const mockReadBody = vi.fn()

vi.mock('h3', () => ({
  defineEventHandler: (fn: any) => fn,
  readBody: mockReadBody,
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/security', async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal()),
  checkIpRateLimit: mockCheckIpRateLimit,
  checkEmailRateLimit: mockCheckEmailRateLimit,
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/errors', () => ({
  sendValidationError: mockSendValidationError,
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository', () => ({
  identityRepository: { requestPasswordReset: mockRequestPasswordReset },
}))

describe('POST /api/auth/forget-password (AUD-04)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    mockCheckIpRateLimit.mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    mockCheckEmailRateLimit.mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    mockRequestPasswordReset.mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    mockSendValidationError.mockImplementation((msg: string) => {
      throw new Error(msg)
    })
  })

  it('checks IP rate limit before reading the body', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ email: 'user@example.com' })
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/forget-password.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = {} as any

    await handler(event)

    expect(mockCheckIpRateLimit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(event)
  })

  it('validates email format', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ email: 'not-an-email' })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/forget-password.post').then((m) => m.default)

    await expect(handler({} as any)).rejects.toThrow('Valid email is required')
    expect(mockRequestPasswordReset).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('AUD-14: rejects oversized email before the rate-limit key', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ email: `${'a'.repeat(300)}@example.com` })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/forget-password.post').then((m) => m.default)

    await expect(handler({} as any)).rejects.toThrow('Valid email is required')
    expect(mockCheckEmailRateLimit).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mockRequestPasswordReset).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('checks the per-email rate limit and delegates with the normalized email', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ email: 'USER@Example.com ' })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/forget-password.post').then((m) => m.default)

    const result = await handler({} as any)

    expect(mockCheckEmailRateLimit).toHaveBeenCalledWith({} as any, 'user@example.com')
    expect(mockRequestPasswordReset).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user@example.com')
    expect(result).toEqual({
      status: true,
      message: 'If this email exists in our system, check your email for the reset link',
    })
  })

  it('returns the generic message for unknown emails (anti-enumeration)', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ email: 'unknown@example.com' })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/forget-password.post').then((m) => m.default)

    const result = await handler({} as any)

    expect(result.status).toBe(true)
    expect(mockRequestPasswordReset).toHaveBeenCalledWith('unknown@example.com')
  })

  it('propagates upstream errors', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ email: 'user@example.com' })
    const upstream: any = new Error('db down')
    upstream.statusCode = 503
    mockRequestPasswordReset.mockRejectedValue(upstream)

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/forget-password.post').then((m) => m.default)
```

```
    await expect(handler({} as any)).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 503 })
  })
})
```

## FILE: server/api/auth/logout.post.spec.ts

```
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

const mockGetAuth = vi.fn()
const mockSignOut = vi.fn()
const mockCreateAuthEvent = vi.fn()
const mockSendUnauthorizedError = vi.fn()
const mockSendAuthUnavailableError = vi.fn()
const mockGetClientIp = vi.fn()
const mockAppendResponseHeaders = vi.fn()

vi.mock('h3', () => ({
  defineEventHandler: (fn: any) => fn,
  appendResponseHeaders: mockAppendResponseHeaders,
  createError: (opts: any) => {
    const err = new Error(opts.message)
    ;(err as any).status = opts.status
    ;(err as any).statusCode = opts.status
    throw err
  },
}))
vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/ip', () => ({
  getClientIp: mockGetClientIp,
}))

vi.mock('#shared/auth', () => ({
  getAuth: mockGetAuth,
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/errors', () => ({
  sendUnauthorizedError: mockSendUnauthorizedError,
  sendAuthUnavailableError: mockSendAuthUnavailableError,
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/audit', () => ({
  createAuthEvent: mockCreateAuthEvent,
}))

describe('POST /api/auth/logout', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    mockGetAuth.mockResolvedValue({ api: { signOut: mockSignOut } })
    mockSendUnauthorizedError.mockImplementation((msg: string) => {
      throw new Error(msg)
    })
    mockSendAuthUnavailableError.mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error('Authentication service is starting. Please try again.')
    })
  })

  it('returns 200 with success message on logout', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/logout.post').then((m) => m.default)
    mockSignOut.mockResolvedValue({ headers: new Headers(), response: { success: true } })

    const event = {
      context: {
        session: { id: 'session-123' },
      },
      headers: new Headers(),
    } as any

    const result = await handler(event)

    expect(result).toEqual({ message: 'Logged out successfully' })
    expect(mockSignOut).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      headers: event.headers,
      returnHeaders: true,
    })
  })

  it('forwards the session-expiry Set-Cookie from signOut', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/logout.post').then((m) => m.default)
    const headers = new Headers()
    headers.append('set-cookie', 'merp-session_token=; Max-Age=0; Path=/')
    mockSignOut.mockResolvedValue({ headers, response: { success: true } })

    const event = {
      context: { session: { id: 'session-123' } },
      headers: new Headers(),
    } as any

    await handler(event)

    expect(mockAppendResponseHeaders).toHaveBeenCalledWith(event, {
      'set-cookie': ['merp-session_token=; Max-Age=0; Path=/'],
    })
  })

  it('returns 401 when no active session exists', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/logout.post').then((m) => m.default)

    const event = {
      context: {},
      headers: new Headers(),
    } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('No active session.')
    expect(mockSignOut).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('returns 401 when session is undefined', async () => {
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/logout.post').then((m) => m.default)

    const event = {
      context: { session: undefined },
      headers: new Headers(),
    } as any

    await expect(handler(event)).rejects.toThrow('No active session.')
    expect(mockSignOut).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
```

```
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

  },
}))

      },

    expect(result.activeCompanyId).toBeNull()
    expect(mockGetActiveCompany).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
```

```
})

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/reset-password.post').then((m) => m.default)

    expect(mockCheckIpRateLimit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(event)
  })

  it('rejects passwords shorter than 8 characters', async () => {

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/reset-password.post').then((m) => m.default)

    await expect(handler({} as any)).rejects.toThrow('Password must be at least 8 characters')
    expect(mockResetPassword).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('AUD-14: rejects oversized passwords before delegating', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ token: 'reset-token', newPassword: 'x'.repeat(1000) })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/reset-password.post').then((m) => m.default)

    await expect(handler({} as any)).rejects.toThrow('Password must be at most 128 characters')
    expect(mockResetPassword).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/reset-password.post').then((m) => m.default)

    await expect(handler({} as any)).rejects.toThrow(

    )
    expect(mockResetPassword).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('rejects requests without a token', async () => {

    mockGetQuery.mockReturnValue({})

    expect(mockResetPassword).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
```

```
const mockSendVerificationEmail = vi.fn()
const mockCheckIpRateLimit = vi.fn()

}))

}))

  sendValidationError: mockSendValidationError,
}))

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository', () => ({
  identityRepository: { sendVerificationEmail: mockSendVerificationEmail },
}))

describe('POST /api/auth/send-verification-email (AUD-04)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    mockCheckIpRateLimit.mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    mockCheckEmailRateLimit.mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    mockSendVerificationEmail.mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    mockSendValidationError.mockImplementation((msg: string) => {
      throw new Error(msg)
    })
  })

  it('checks IP rate limit before reading the body', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ email: 'user@example.com' })
    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/send-verification-email.post').then(
      (m) => m.default,
    )
    const event = {} as any

    await handler(event)

    expect(mockCheckIpRateLimit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(event)
  })

  it('validates email format', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ email: 'not-an-email' })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/send-verification-email.post').then(
      (m) => m.default,
    )

    await expect(handler({} as any)).rejects.toThrow('Valid email is required')
    expect(mockSendVerificationEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('AUD-14: rejects oversized email before the rate-limit key', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ email: `${'a'.repeat(300)}@example.com` })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/send-verification-email.post').then(
      (m) => m.default,
    )

    await expect(handler({} as any)).rejects.toThrow('Valid email is required')
    expect(mockCheckEmailRateLimit).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mockSendVerificationEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('checks the per-email rate limit before delegating', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ email: 'USER@Example.com ' })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/send-verification-email.post').then(
      (m) => m.default,
    )

    const result = await handler({} as any)

    expect(mockCheckEmailRateLimit).toHaveBeenCalledWith({} as any, 'user@example.com')
    expect(mockSendVerificationEmail).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user@example.com')
    expect(result).toEqual({ status: true })
  })

  it('returns generic success regardless of whether the account exists (anti-enumeration)', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ email: 'unknown@example.com' })

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/send-verification-email.post').then(
      (m) => m.default,
    )

    const result = await handler({} as any)

    expect(result).toEqual({ status: true })
    expect(mockSendVerificationEmail).toHaveBeenCalledWith('unknown@example.com')
  })

  it('propagates upstream errors', async () => {
    mockReadBody.mockResolvedValue({ email: 'user@example.com' })
    const upstream: any = new Error('db down')
    upstream.statusCode = 503
    mockSendVerificationEmail.mockRejectedValue(upstream)

    const handler = await import('~~/server/api/auth/send-verification-email.post').then(
      (m) => m.default,
    )

    await expect(handler({} as any)).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 503 })
```
```
  })
})
```

```
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

const mockSetResponseStatus = vi.fn()
const mockSetResponseHeaders = vi.fn()
const mockSend = vi.fn()
const mockLoggerError = vi.fn()

vi.mock('h3', () => ({
  setResponseStatus: mockSetResponseStatus,
  setResponseHeaders: mockSetResponseHeaders,
  send: mockSend,
}))

vi.mock('nitropack/runtime', () => ({
  defineNitroErrorHandler: (fn: any) => fn,
}))

vi.mock('#shared/logger', () => ({
  logger: { error: mockLoggerError },
}))

describe('error-handler (FR-026)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
  })

  it('passes through contract JSON errors with status < 500', async () => {
    const error = {
      statusCode: 401,
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    }
    const event = {} as any

    const handler = await import('~~/server/error-handler').then((m) => m.default)
    await handler(error, event)

    expect(mockSetResponseStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith(event, 401)
    expect(mockSend).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      event,
      JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Authentication required.' }),
    )
    expect(mockLoggerError).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('AUD-14: always sets JSON content-type on error responses', async () => {
    const error = {
      statusCode: 403,
      message: JSON.stringify({ error: 'forbidden', message: 'nope' }),
    }
    const event = {} as any

    const handler = await import('~~/server/error-handler').then((m) => m.default)
    await handler(error, event)

    expect(mockSetResponseHeaders).toHaveBeenCalledWith(event, {
      'content-type': 'application/json',
    })
  })

  it('turns generic 500 errors into internal_error without leaking the message', async () => {
    const error = new Error('database connection refused')
    ;(error as any).statusCode = 500
    const event = {} as any

    const handler = await import('~~/server/error-handler').then((m) => m.default)
    await handler(error, event)

    expect(mockSetResponseStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith(event, 500)
    expect(mockSend).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      event,
      JSON.stringify({ error: 'internal_error', message: 'Internal server error' }),
    )

    const body = mockSend.mock.calls[0][1]
    expect(body).not.toContain('database connection refused')
    expect(body).not.toContain(error.stack)

    expect(mockLoggerError).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'Unhandled server error',
      expect.objectContaining({ message: 'database connection refused' }),
    )
  })

  it('does not pass through contract payloads with status >= 500', async () => {
    const error = {
      statusCode: 500,
      message: JSON.stringify({
        error: 'db',
        message: 'postgres://user:secret@internal-host:5432',
      }),
    }
    const event = {} as any

    const handler = await import('~~/server/error-handler').then((m) => m.default)
    await handler(error, event)

    expect(mockSend).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      event,
      JSON.stringify({ error: 'internal_error', message: 'Internal server error' }),
    )
  })

  it('turns non-JSON messages into internal_error without leaking the raw message', async () => {
    const error = new Error("TypeError: cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'x')")
    ;(error as any).statusCode = 400
    const event = {} as any

    const handler = await import('~~/server/error-handler').then((m) => m.default)
    await handler(error, event)

    expect(mockSetResponseStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith(event, 500)
    expect(mockSend).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      event,
      JSON.stringify({ error: 'internal_error', message: 'Internal server error' }),
    )
  })
})
```

```
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

const mockGetRequestURL = vi.fn()

vi.mock('h3', () => ({

  getRequestURL: (...args: any[]) => mockGetRequestURL(...args),
  setResponseHeaders: (event: any, headers: Record<string, string>) => {
    event.resHeaders = { ...(event.resHeaders ?? {}), ...headers }
  },
}))

const NO_STORE = 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'

describe('No-store middleware', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
  })

  it('AUD-17: sets no-store on /api/ paths', async () => {
    mockGetRequestURL.mockReturnValue(new URL('http://localhost:3000/api/auth/me'))

    const handler = await import('~~/server/middleware/00-no-store').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { resHeaders: {} } as any

    await handler(event)

    expect(event.resHeaders['cache-control']).toBe(NO_STORE)
  })

  it('AUD-17: does not set no-store on non-/api/ paths', async () => {
    mockGetRequestURL.mockReturnValue(new URL('http://localhost:3000/'))

    const handler = await import('~~/server/middleware/00-no-store').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { resHeaders: {} } as any

    await handler(event)

    expect(event.resHeaders['cache-control']).toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('AUD-17: headers stay on the event when the handler throws', async () => {
    mockGetRequestURL.mockReturnValue(new URL('http://localhost:3000/api/auth/me'))

    const handler = await import('~~/server/middleware/00-no-store').then((m) => m.default)
    const event = { resHeaders: {} } as any

    await handler(event)

    await expect(Promise.reject(new Error('handler crashed'))).rejects.toThrow()
    expect(event.resHeaders['cache-control']).toBe(NO_STORE)
  })
})
```

```
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'

vi.mock('nitropack/runtime', () => ({
  defineNitroPlugin: (fn: any) => fn,
}))

import { missingProductionEnv } from './validate-env'

describe('missingProductionEnv (AUD-05 + AUD-24)', () => {
  it('returns empty outside production (BETTER_AUTH_SECRET ausente = ok)', () => {
    expect(missingProductionEnv({ NODE_ENV: 'development' })).toEqual([])
  })

  it('flags missing CORS_ORIGIN, BETTER_AUTH_URL, APP_DATABASE_URL and BETTER_AUTH_SECRET in production', () => {
    expect(missingProductionEnv({ NODE_ENV: 'production' })).toEqual([
      'CORS_ORIGIN',
      'BETTER_AUTH_URL',
      'APP_DATABASE_URL',
      'BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (mínimo 32 caracteres)',
    ])
    expect(
      missingProductionEnv({
        NODE_ENV: 'production',
        CORS_ORIGIN: 'https://app.example.com',
        APP_DATABASE_URL: 'postgres://app:pw@db:5432/merp',
      }),
    ).toEqual(['BETTER_AUTH_URL', 'BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (mínimo 32 caracteres)'])
  })

  it('AUD-24: flags BETTER_AUTH_SECRET with fewer than 32 characters in production', () => {
    expect(
      missingProductionEnv({ NODE_ENV: 'production', BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: 'short-secret' }),
    ).toContain('BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (mínimo 32 caracteres)')
    expect(
      missingProductionEnv({
        NODE_ENV: 'production',
        BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: 'a'.repeat(31),
      }),
    ).toContain('BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (mínimo 32 caracteres)')
  })

  it('AUD-24: accepts BETTER_AUTH_SECRET with length >= 32 in production', () => {
    expect(
      missingProductionEnv({ NODE_ENV: 'production', BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: 'a'.repeat(32) }),
    ).not.toContain('BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (mínimo 32 caracteres)')
  })

  it('requires TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS when TRUST_PROXY=true in production', () => {
    expect(missingProductionEnv({ NODE_ENV: 'production', TRUST_PROXY: 'true' })).toContain(
      'TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS (obrigatória quando TRUST_PROXY=true)',
    )
    expect(
      missingProductionEnv({
        NODE_ENV: 'production',
        TRUST_PROXY: 'true',
        TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS: '10.0.0.0/8',
      }),
    ).not.toContain('TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS (obrigatória quando TRUST_PROXY=true)')
  })

  it('throws on malformed CIDR even in the missing check', () => {
    expect(() =>
      missingProductionEnv({
        NODE_ENV: 'production',
        TRUST_PROXY: 'true',
        TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS: 'x/8',
      }),
    ).toThrow(/TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS inválido/)
  })

  it('is satisfied when everything is set', () => {
    expect(
      missingProductionEnv({
        NODE_ENV: 'production',
        CORS_ORIGIN: 'https://app.example.com',
        BETTER_AUTH_URL: 'https://app.example.com',
        APP_DATABASE_URL: 'postgres://app:pw@db:5432/merp',
        BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: 'a'.repeat(32),
        TRUST_PROXY: 'false',
      }),
    ).toEqual([])
  })
})

```
```
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest'
import { execSync } from 'child_process'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url'
import { dirname, resolve } from 'path'
import postgres from 'postgres'
import { buildCustomSql } from './apply-custom-sql'

// Regressão do ordering 0015/0017: banco limpo quebrava em 0015
// (GRANT ... TO merp_app antes da role existir na 0017). A 0014_app_role_ensure
// garante a role cedo no stream; estes testes provam (a) migrations-só,
// (b) bootstrap-primeiro, (c) reaplicação e (d) RLS funcional pós-fix.
const dbAvailable = process.env.DB_AVAILABLE === 'true'

const OWNER_URL = 'postgres://merp:merp@localhost:5432/postgres'
const APP_PASSWORD = 'test-merp-app-pw'
const repoRoot = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..')
const stamp = `${Date.now().toString(36)}${process.pid.toString(36)}`
const dbA = `merp_reg_a_${stamp}`
const dbB = `merp_reg_b_${stamp}`

interface RoleAttrs {
  login: boolean
  bypassrls: boolean
  inherit: boolean
  hasPassword: boolean
}

// Divide o SQL concatenado em statements, respeitando dollar-quoting ($$),
// aspas e comentários — espelha o psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 (fail-fast por
// statement, sem máscara de erro).
function splitStatements(sql: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = []
  let cur = ''
  let i = 0
  let quote: string | null = null
  let dollar: string | null = null
  let lineComment = false
  let blockComment = false
  while (i < sql.length) {
    const c = sql[i]
    const two = sql.slice(i, i + 2)
    if (lineComment) {
      cur += c
      if (c === '\n') lineComment = false
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (blockComment) {
      cur += c
      if (two === '*/') {
        cur += sql[i + 1]
        i += 2
        blockComment = false
        continue
      }
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (quote) {
      cur += c
      if (c === quote && sql[i - 1] !== '\\') quote = null
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (dollar) {
      if (sql.startsWith(dollar, i)) {
        cur += dollar
        i += dollar.length
        dollar = null
        continue
      }
      cur += c
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (two === '--' && !cur.endsWith(':')) {
      // '--' fora de cast '::' — comentário de linha (casts não ocorrem aqui
      // colados em statement, mas a guarda evita falso-positivo barato)
      lineComment = true
      cur += c
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (two === '/*') {
      blockComment = true
      cur += two
      i += 2
      continue
    }
    if (c === "'" || c === '"') {
      quote = c
      cur += c
      i++
      continue
    }
    const m = /^\$[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\$|^\$\$/.exec(sql.slice(i))
    if (m) {
      dollar = m[0]
      cur += dollar
      i += dollar.length
      continue
    }
    if (c === ';') {
      cur += c
      out.push(cur)
      cur = ''
      i++
      continue
    }
    cur += c
    i++
  }
  if (cur.trim()) out.push(cur)
  // Descarta chunks só de comentários/espaço (psql os ignoraria).
  return out.filter((s) => s.replace(/--[^\n]*|\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '').trim())
}

async function freshDb(name: string): Promise<void> {
  const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
  try {
    await admin.unsafe(`CREATE DATABASE ${name} OWNER merp`)
  } finally {
    await admin.end()
  }
}

async function dropDb(name: string): Promise<void> {
  const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
  try {
    await admin.unsafe(`DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS ${name} WITH (FORCE)`)
  } finally {
    await admin.end()
  }
}

function pushSchema(dbUrl: string): void {
  try {
    execSync(`npx drizzle-kit push --config="${resolve(repoRoot, 'drizzle.config.ts')}"`, {
      cwd: repoRoot,
      env: { ...process.env, DATABASE_URL: dbUrl },
      encoding: 'utf-8',
      stdio: 'pipe',
      timeout: 240_000,
    })
  } catch (error: any) {
    // stdio pipe engole a saída — anexa para o flake ser diagnosticável.
    const out = [error?.stdout, error?.stderr].filter(Boolean).join('\n')
    throw new Error(`drizzle-kit push falhou: ${error?.message}${out ? `\n${out}` : ''}`)
  }
}

// Aplica o custom SQL statement a statement (fail-fast como ON_ERROR_STOP).
async function applyCustom(dbUrl: string): Promise<void> {
  const sql = postgres(dbUrl)
  try {
    for (const stmt of splitStatements(buildCustomSql())) {
      await sql.unsafe(stmt)
    }
  } finally {
    await sql.end()
  }
}

async function roleAttrs(): Promise<RoleAttrs | null> {
  const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
  try {
    const rows = await admin.unsafe(
      `SELECT rolcanlogin, rolbypassrls, rolinherit, rolpassword IS NOT NULL AS has_password FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'merp_app'`,
    )
    if (rows.length === 0) return null
    const r = rows[0] as any
    return {
      login: r.rolcanlogin,
      bypassrls: r.rolbypassrls,
      inherit: r.rolinherit,
      hasPassword: r.has_password,
    }
  } finally {
    await admin.end()
  }
}

// Garante existência SEM tocar em credencial: roles são cluster-globais e os
// demais arquivos de integração autenticam como merp_app/'merp_app' em
// paralelo — um ALTER ROLE ... PASSWORD aqui causaria flake na suíte.
// A parte de existência é o que importa para o ordering (o bug era
// 'role does not exist'); a cláusula PASSWORD do ensureAppRole já é exercida
// pelo próprio globalSetup em CI.
async function ensureRoleExists(): Promise<void> {
  const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
  try {
    await admin.unsafe(
      `DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'merp_app') THEN CREATE ROLE merp_app WITH LOGIN; END IF; END $$;`,
    )
  } finally {
    await admin.end()
  }
}

async function rolePreExists(): Promise<boolean> {
  const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
  try {
    const rows = await admin.unsafe(`SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'merp_app'`)
    return rows.length > 0
  } finally {
    await admin.end()
  }
}

const urlFor = (db: string, user = 'merp', pw = 'merp') =>
  `postgres://${user}:${pw}@localhost:5432/${db}`

describe.skipIf(!dbAvailable)('migration ordering 0015/0017 (integration)', () => {
  let attrsA: RoleAttrs | null = null
  let preExisted = false

  beforeAll(async () => {
    preExisted = await rolePreExists()
    // (a) banco limpo, migrations-só, sem criar a role manualmente.
    await freshDb(dbA)
    pushSchema(urlFor(dbA))
    await applyCustom(urlFor(dbA))
    attrsA = await roleAttrs()

    // (b) banco limpo, bootstrap (existência) primeiro.
    await freshDb(dbB)
    await ensureRoleExists()
    pushSchema(urlFor(dbB))
    await applyCustom(urlFor(dbB))
  }, 300_000)

  afterAll(async () => {
    await dropDb(dbA).catch(() => {})
    await dropDb(dbB).catch(() => {})
  })

  it('(a) migrations-só passam e criam merp_app com atributos RLS-safe', () => {
    // Se a 0014_app_role_ensure regredir, o applyCustom acima lança
    // 'role "merp_app" does not exist' e este teste falha no beforeAll.
    expect(attrsA).toMatchObject({ login: true, bypassrls: false, inherit: true })
    // Em cluster 100% limpo a migration cria a role sem senha (credencial é
    // da operação/bootstrap). Com globalSetup ativo a role já existe — aí a
    // não-interferência é coberta por (c).
    if (!preExisted) expect(attrsA?.hasPassword).toBe(false)
  })

  it('(c) reaplicar em banco migrado passa e não altera a role', async () => {
    const before = await roleAttrs()
    await applyCustom(urlFor(dbA))
    expect(await roleAttrs()).toEqual(before)
  })

  it('(b) bootstrap-primeiro resulta nos mesmos atributos de (a)', async () => {
    const attrsB = await roleAttrs()
    expect(attrsB).not.toBeNull()
    // Existência + atributos idênticos independente de quem criou primeiro.
    expect({
      login: attrsB?.login,
      bypassrls: attrsB?.bypassrls,
      inherit: attrsB?.inherit,
    }).toEqual({ login: attrsA?.login, bypassrls: attrsA?.bypassrls, inherit: attrsA?.inherit })
  })

  describe('(d) RLS funcional pós-fix', () => {
    const OWNER = 'rls-u-owner'
    const OUTSIDER = 'rls-u-out'
    const CO_A = 'rls-c-a'
    const CO_B = 'rls-c-b'
    // Role descartável membro de merp_app: herda os mesmos grants (INHERIT),
    // mas continua NOBYPASSRLS (bypass não se herda) — exerce exatamente as
    // mesmas policies, sem mutar a credencial global de merp_app (paralelismo).
    const PROBE = `rls_probe_${stamp}`

    // Conexão dedicada como probe com GUCs de tenant/user (como withTenant).
    async function asApp<T>(
      tenant: string | null,
      user: string,
      fn: (sql: any) => Promise<T>,
    ): Promise<T> {
      const sql = postgres(urlFor(dbA, PROBE, APP_PASSWORD))
      try {
        await sql.unsafe(`SET app.tenant_id = '${tenant ?? ''}'`)
        await sql.unsafe(`SET app.user_id = '${user}'`)
        return await fn(sql)
      } finally {
        await sql.end()
      }
    }

    beforeAll(async () => {
      const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
      try {
        await admin.unsafe(`CREATE ROLE ${PROBE} WITH LOGIN PASSWORD '${APP_PASSWORD}'`)
        await admin.unsafe(`GRANT merp_app TO ${PROBE}`)
      } finally {
        await admin.end()
      }
      // Seed como owner (superuser bypassa RLS).
      const owner = postgres(urlFor(dbA))
      try {
        await owner.unsafe(
          `INSERT INTO "user" (id, name, email) VALUES ('${OWNER}', 'Owner', 'rls-owner@example.com'), ('${OUTSIDER}', 'Outsider', 'rls-outsider@example.com') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING`,
        )
        await owner.unsafe(
          `INSERT INTO company (id, name) VALUES ('${CO_A}', 'RLS Co A'), ('${CO_B}', 'RLS Co B') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING`,
        )
        await owner.unsafe(
          `INSERT INTO company_member (company_id, user_id, role) VALUES ('${CO_A}', '${OWNER}', 'owner') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
        )
      } finally {
        await owner.end()
      }
    }, 60_000)

    afterAll(async () => {
      const admin = postgres(OWNER_URL)
      try {
        await admin.unsafe(`DROP ROLE IF EXISTS ${PROBE}`)
      } finally {
        await admin.end().catch(() => {})
      }
    })

    it('só enxerga rows do tenant corrente (policy ativa)', async () => {
      const rows = await asApp(CO_A, OWNER, (sql) =>
        sql.unsafe(`SELECT id FROM company ORDER BY id`),
      )
      expect(rows.map((r: any) => r.id)).toEqual([CO_A])
    })

    it('sem contexto o outsider não vê nada (fail-closed)', async () => {
      const rows = await asApp(null, OUTSIDER, (sql) => sql.unsafe(`SELECT * FROM company_member`))
      expect(rows).toHaveLength(0)
    })

    it('self-insert de outsider em outro tenant é negado (42501)', async () => {
      await expect(
        asApp(CO_B, OUTSIDER, (sql) =>
          sql.unsafe(
            `INSERT INTO company_member (company_id, user_id, role) VALUES ('${CO_B}', '${OUTSIDER}', 'member')`,
          ),
        ),
      ).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: '42501' })
    })

    it('role de migration continua enxergando tudo', async () => {
      const owner = postgres(urlFor(dbA))
      try {
        const companies = await owner.unsafe(`SELECT id FROM company ORDER BY id`)
        expect(companies.map((r: any) => r.id)).toEqual([CO_A, CO_B])
        const members = await owner.unsafe(`SELECT * FROM company_member`)
        expect(members).toHaveLength(1)
      } finally {
        await owner.end()
      }
    })
  })
})
```

```
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { escapeLikePattern } from './repository'

describe('escapeLikePattern', () => {
  it('escapes % wildcards', () => {
    expect(escapeLikePattern('50%')).toBe('50\\%')
    expect(escapeLikePattern('%%')).toBe('\\%\\%')
  })

  it('escapes _ wildcards', () => {
    expect(escapeLikePattern('_a')).toBe('\\_a')
  })

  it('escapes backslashes', () => {
    expect(escapeLikePattern('a\\b')).toBe('a\\\\b')
  })

  it('leaves plain strings untouched', () => {
    expect(escapeLikePattern('acme')).toBe('acme')
  })
})
```

```
      const companyB = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Company B' }, userB.id)

      expect(userACompanies[0].id).toBe(companyA.id)

      const userBCompanies = await repo.findUserCompanies(userB.id)
      expect(userBCompanies).toHaveLength(1)
      expect(userBCompanies[0].id).toBe(companyB.id)
    })

      const emailA = `iso-select-a-${Date.now()}@example.com`
      const emailB = `iso-select-b-${Date.now()}@example.com`

      const rows = await withTenant(null, userA.id, (tx) =>

      )

      const member = await registerUser(`rm-member-${Date.now()}@example.com`, 'RM Member')
      const company = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'RM Company' }, owner.id)
      await repo.createCompanyMember(company.id, member.id, 'member')

      await repo.removeCompanyMember(company.id, owner.id, member.id)

      expect(await repo.getCompanyMembershipRole(member.id, company.id)).toBeNull()
      expect(await repo.getCompanyMembershipRole(owner.id, company.id)).toBe('owner')
    })

    it('lets a member leave the company themselves', async () => {
      const owner = await registerUser(`lv-owner-${Date.now()}@example.com`, 'LV Owner')
      const member = await registerUser(`lv-member-${Date.now()}@example.com`, 'LV Member')
      const company = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'LV Company' }, owner.id)
      await repo.createCompanyMember(company.id, member.id, 'member')

      await repo.removeCompanyMember(company.id, member.id, member.id)

      expect(await repo.getCompanyMembershipRole(member.id, company.id)).toBeNull()
      expect(await repo.getCompanyMembershipRole(owner.id, company.id)).toBe('owner')
    })

    it('backstop RLS: a member cannot remove another member (404, RLS denied)', async () => {
      const owner = await registerUser(`blk-owner-${Date.now()}@example.com`, 'Blk Owner')
      const memberA = await registerUser(`blk-member-a-${Date.now()}@example.com`, 'Blk Member A')
      const memberB = await registerUser(`blk-member-b-${Date.now()}@example.com`, 'Blk Member B')
      const company = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Blk Company' }, owner.id)
      await repo.createCompanyMember(company.id, memberA.id, 'member')
      await repo.createCompanyMember(company.id, memberB.id, 'member')

      await expect(
        repo.removeCompanyMember(company.id, memberA.id, memberB.id),
      ).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 404 })

      expect(await repo.getCompanyMembershipRole(memberA.id, company.id)).toBe('member')
      expect(await repo.getCompanyMembershipRole(memberB.id, company.id)).toBe('member')
    })

    it('clears activeCompanyId on sessions of the removed user', async () => {
      const owner = await registerUser(`clr-owner-${Date.now()}@example.com`, 'Clr Owner')
      const member = await registerUser(`clr-member-${Date.now()}@example.com`, 'Clr Member')
      const company = await repo.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Clr Company' }, owner.id)
      await repo.createCompanyMember(company.id, member.id, 'member')

      const session = await identity.createSession(
        member.id,
        `clr-token-${Date.now()}`,
        new Date(Date.now() + 60_000),
        false,
      )
      await repo.setActiveCompany(session.id, company.id, member.id)
      expect(await repo.getActiveCompany(session.id)).toBe(company.id)

      await repo.removeCompanyMember(company.id, owner.id, member.id)

      expect(await repo.getActiveCompany(session.id)).toBeNull()
    })
  })
})
```

```
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

const {
  mockGetAuth,
  mockSignInEmail,
  mockSendVerificationEmail,
  mockVerifyEmail,
  mockRequestPasswordReset,
  mockResetPassword,
  mockLimit,
  mockWhereDelete,
  mockLoggerWarn,
} = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  mockGetAuth: vi.fn(),
  mockSignInEmail: vi.fn(),
  mockSendVerificationEmail: vi.fn(),
  mockVerifyEmail: vi.fn(),
  mockRequestPasswordReset: vi.fn(),
  mockResetPassword: vi.fn(),
  mockLimit: vi.fn(async () => []),
  mockWhereDelete: vi.fn(async () => undefined),
  mockLoggerWarn: vi.fn(),
}))

vi.mock('#shared/auth', () => ({
  getAuth: mockGetAuth,
}))

vi.mock('#shared/logger', () => ({
  logger: { warn: mockLoggerWarn, error: vi.fn(), info: vi.fn() },
}))

vi.mock('../../db', () => ({
  db: {
    select: vi.fn(() => ({
      from: vi.fn(() => ({
        where: vi.fn(() => ({
          limit: mockLimit,
        })),
      })),
    })),
    delete: vi.fn(() => ({
      where: mockWhereDelete,
    })),
  },
}))

function mockAuthApi() {
  mockGetAuth.mockResolvedValue({
    api: {
      signInEmail: mockSignInEmail,
      sendVerificationEmail: mockSendVerificationEmail,
      verifyEmail: mockVerifyEmail,
      requestPasswordReset: mockRequestPasswordReset,
      resetPassword: mockResetPassword,
    },
  })
}

function mockUserRow(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return {
    id: 'user-1',
    email: 'existing@example.com',
```

```
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, vi } from 'vitest'

const INTEGRATION_DB_URL = 'postgres://merp_app:merp_app@localhost:5432/merp_test'
const testEmail = `test-${Date.now()}@example.com`
const testPassword = 'test-password-123'

// AUD-04: os envios de email são mockados — capturamos os links (e tokens)
// gerados pelo better-auth para exercitar o fluxo real de verificação/reset
// contra o banco. O mock é registrado antes de qualquer import de
// shared/auth (getAuth) via hoisting do vi.mock.
const capturedVerificationLinks: Array<{ email: string; link: string }> = []
const capturedResetLinks: Array<{ email: string; link: string }> = []

vi.mock('~~/server/utils/shared/email', async (importOriginal) => {
  const original = await importOriginal<typeof import('~~/server/utils/shared/email')>()
  return {
    ...original,
    sendVerificationEmailLink: async (email: string, link: string) => {
      capturedVerificationLinks.push({ email, link })
    },
    sendPasswordResetLink: async (email: string, link: string) => {
      capturedResetLinks.push({ email, link })
    },
  }
})

function linkFor(captured: Array<{ email: string; link: string }>, email: string): string {
  const entry = [...captured].reverse().find((e) => e.email === email)
  if (!entry) throw new Error(`No email captured for ${email}`)
  return entry.link
}

function tokenFromLink(link: string): string {
  const token = new URL(link).searchParams.get('token')
  if (!token) throw new Error(`No token in link: ${link}`)
  return token
}

function resetTokenFromLink(link: string): string {
  const match = link.match(/\/reset-password\/([^/?]+)/)
  if (!match) throw new Error(`No reset token in link: ${link}`)
  return match[1]
}

async function verifyEmailLink(link: string): Promise<void> {
  const { getAuth } = await import('#shared/auth')
  const auth = await getAuth()
  await auth.api.verifyEmail({ query: { token: tokenFromLink(link) } })
}

const dbAvailable = process.env.DB_AVAILABLE === 'true'
```

```
import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll } from 'vitest'

const INTEGRATION_DB_URL = 'postgres://merp_app:merp_app@localhost:5432/merp_test'

const dbAvailable = process.env.DB_AVAILABLE === 'true'

describe.skipIf(!dbAvailable)('InviteRepository (integration)', () => {
  let repo: any
  let company: any
  let identity: any

  beforeAll(async () => {
    process.env.APP_DATABASE_URL = INTEGRATION_DB_URL
    repo = new (await import('~~/server/utils/auth/invite/repository')).InviteRepository()
    company = new (await import('~~/server/utils/auth/company/repository')).CompanyRepository()
    identity = new (await import('~~/server/utils/auth/identity/repository')).IdentityRepository()
  })

  const registerUser = (email: string, name: string) =>
    identity.register({ email, password: 'password123', name })

  it('creates, lists, finds and accepts an invite by token', async () => {
    const ownerEmail = `owner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const inviteeEmail = `invitee-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Owner')
    const invitee = await registerUser(inviteeEmail, 'Invitee')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner(
      { name: 'Invite Company' },
      owner.id,
    )

    const created = await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: inviteeEmail,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })
    expect(created).toMatchObject({ companyId: createdCompany.id, email: inviteeEmail })
    expect(created.token).toBeTruthy()
    // AUD-01: hash nunca sai do repositório — o que segue para a API é só o token
    expect(created).not.toHaveProperty('tokenHash')
    expect(created.expiresAt.getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now())

    const pending = await repo.findPendingInvite(createdCompany.id, inviteeEmail)
    expect(pending?.id).toBe(created.id)

    const listed = await repo.listCompanyInvites(createdCompany.id)
    expect(listed.map((i: any) => i.id)).toContain(created.id)

    const accepted = await repo.acceptInvite(created.token, inviteeEmail, invitee.id)
    expect(accepted.acceptedAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date)

    expect(await repo.findPendingInvite(createdCompany.id, inviteeEmail)).toBeNull()
    expect(await company.isCompanyMember(invitee.id, createdCompany.id)).toBe(true)
    expect(await company.getCompanyMembershipRole(invitee.id, createdCompany.id)).toBe('member')
  })

  it('rejects duplicate invites for the same company and email', async () => {
    const ownerEmail = `dupowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const inviteeEmail = `dupinvitee-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Dup Owner')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Dup Company' }, owner.id)

    await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: inviteeEmail,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })

    await expect(
      repo.createInvite({ companyId: createdCompany.id, email: inviteeEmail, invitedBy: owner.id }),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 409 })
  })

  it('returns null for expired invites', async () => {
    const ownerEmail = `expowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Exp Owner')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Exp Company' }, owner.id)

    const { withTenant } = await import('~~/server/utils/auth/tenant-context')
    const { invite } = await import('~~/server/utils/schema')
    const { eq } = await import('drizzle-orm')

    const created = await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: `expired-${Date.now()}@example.com`,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })

    await withTenant(createdCompany.id, owner.id, async (tx) => {
      await tx
        .update(invite)
        .set({ expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 60_000) })
        .where(eq(invite.id, created.id))
    })

    // AUD-01: token expirado também não aceita
    await expect(repo.acceptInvite(created.token, created.email, owner.id)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 404,
    })
  })

  it('is single-use: a consumed token cannot be accepted again', async () => {
    const ownerEmail = `oneowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const inviteeEmail = `oneinvitee-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'One Owner')
    const invitee = await registerUser(inviteeEmail, 'One Invitee')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'One Company' }, owner.id)

    const created = await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: inviteeEmail,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })

    await repo.acceptInvite(created.token, inviteeEmail, invitee.id)
    await expect(repo.acceptInvite(created.token, inviteeEmail, invitee.id)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 404,
    })
  })

  it('rejects a token presented by a different email (posse do token + email da sessão)', async () => {
    const ownerEmail = `diffowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const inviteeEmail = `diffinvitee-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const otherEmail = `other-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Diff Owner')
    const invitee = await registerUser(inviteeEmail, 'Diff Invitee')
    const other = await registerUser(otherEmail, 'Other User')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Diff Company' }, owner.id)

    const created = await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: inviteeEmail,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })

    await expect(repo.acceptInvite(created.token, otherEmail, other.id)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 404,
    })

    // o convite segue válido para o destinatário certo
    const pending = await repo.findPendingInvite(createdCompany.id, inviteeEmail)
    expect(pending?.id).toBe(created.id)
    expect(await company.isCompanyMember(other.id, createdCompany.id)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('rejects a forged token (nothing matches an unknown hash)', async () => {
    const ownerEmail = `forgedowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const inviteeEmail = `forgedinvitee-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Forged Owner')
    const invitee = await registerUser(inviteeEmail, 'Forged Invitee')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner(
      { name: 'Forged Company' },
      owner.id,
    )

    const created = await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: inviteeEmail,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })

    await expect(
      repo.acceptInvite(`${created.token}x`, inviteeEmail, invitee.id),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({ statusCode: 404 })
  })

  it('RLS backstop: direct member self-insert without token or bootstrap flag is denied', async () => {
    // AUD-01: mesmo que o check de app fosse removido, a policy cm_insert_policy
    // nega o self-insert sem token_hash válido (não setamos o flag de bootstrap).
    const ownerEmail = `rlsowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const attackerEmail = `rlsattacker-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Rls Owner')
    const attacker = await registerUser(attackerEmail, 'Rls Attacker')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Rls Company' }, owner.id)

    const { withTenant } = await import('~~/server/utils/auth/tenant-context')
    const { companyMember } = await import('~~/server/utils/schema')

    await expect(
      withTenant(createdCompany.id, attacker.id, async (tx) => {
        await tx.insert(companyMember).values({
          companyId: createdCompany.id,
          userId: attacker.id,
          role: 'member',
        })
      }),
    ).rejects.toThrow()

    expect(await company.isCompanyMember(attacker.id, createdCompany.id)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('RLS backstop: member (non-owner) cannot UPDATE invites in the company', async () => {
    // AUD-01 residual: a policy antiga (invite_update_policy sem check de role)
    // deixava qualquer member alterar invites pendentes. Agora o UPDATE exige
    // owner OU o claim por token — member sem token é negado no banco.
    const ownerEmail = `updowner-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const memberEmail = `updmember-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const inviteeEmail = `updinvitee-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const owner = await registerUser(ownerEmail, 'Upd Owner')
    const member = await registerUser(memberEmail, 'Upd Member')
    const createdCompany = await company.createCompanyWithOwner({ name: 'Upd Company' }, owner.id)
    await company.createCompanyMember(createdCompany.id, member.id, 'member')

    const created = await repo.createInvite({
      companyId: createdCompany.id,
      email: inviteeEmail,
      invitedBy: owner.id,
    })

    const { withTenant } = await import('~~/server/utils/auth/tenant-context')
    const { invite } = await import('~~/server/utils/schema')
    const { eq } = await import('drizzle-orm')

    // RLS de UPDATE filtra silenciosamente (0 rows) — o member não vê erro,
    // mas a linha não muda; o invite continua intacto para o destinatário.
    const hijackedEmail = `hijack-${Date.now()}@example.com`
    const rows = await withTenant(createdCompany.id, member.id, async (tx) => {
      return tx
        .update(invite)
        .set({ email: hijackedEmail })
        .where(eq(invite.id, created.id))
        .returning({ id: invite.id })
    })
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(0)

    const pending = await repo.findPendingInvite(createdCompany.id, inviteeEmail)
    expect(pending?.id).toBe(created.id)
    expect(pending?.email).not.toBe(hijackedEmail)
  })
})
```

```
import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest'

const originalNodeEnv = process.env.NODE_ENV

afterEach(() => {
  process.env.NODE_ENV = originalNodeEnv
  vi.resetModules()
})

async function loadWithRequiredSsl(nodeEnv: string) {
  process.env.NODE_ENV = nodeEnv
  return (await import('./db')).withRequiredSsl
}

describe('withRequiredSsl (AUD-05)', () => {
  it('forces sslmode=require in production when the URL has no sslmode', async () => {
    const withRequiredSsl = await loadWithRequiredSsl('production')
    expect(withRequiredSsl('postgres://merp:merp@postgres:5432/merp')).toBe(
      'postgres://merp:merp@postgres:5432/merp?sslmode=require',
    )
  })

  it('upgrades weak sslmodes (prefer/allow/disable) to require in production', async () => {
    const withRequiredSsl = await loadWithRequiredSsl('production')
    expect(withRequiredSsl('postgres://merp:merp@postgres:5432/merp?sslmode=prefer')).toBe(
      'postgres://merp:merp@postgres:5432/merp?sslmode=require',
    )
  })

  it('respects an explicit secure sslmode in production', async () => {
    const withRequiredSsl = await loadWithRequiredSsl('production')
    expect(withRequiredSsl('postgres://merp:merp@postgres:5432/merp?sslmode=verify-full')).toBe(
      'postgres://merp:merp@postgres:5432/merp?sslmode=verify-full',
    )
  })

  it('keeps the URL untouched outside production (dev/test local postgres)', async () => {
    const withRequiredSsl = await loadWithRequiredSsl('development')
    expect(withRequiredSsl('postgres://merp:merp@postgres:5432/merp')).toBe(
      'postgres://merp:merp@postgres:5432/merp',
    )
  })
})
```
